daas-irab:139-140.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَتَّخِذُونَ الْكافِرِينَ أَوْلِياءَ﴾ الذين is a relative noun in the position of the accusative (fī maḥall naṣb) as a naʿt (adjective) of المنافقين, or a badal (substitute); يتخذون is an imperfect verb, the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and الكافرين is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ is its second object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ, being a sound masculine plural. ﴿أَيَبْتَغُونَ عِنْدَهُمُ الْعِزَّةَ؟﴾ an imperfect verb, to which the adverb of place after it is attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and العزة is its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعاً﴾ inna and its noun; the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); جميعا is a ḥāl, and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿وَقَدْ نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun عليكم, and likewise في الكتاب, are attached to the verb نزل, a past verb, passive [Translator's note: so in the source; نَزَّلَ as vocalized is active, with Allah as the implied agent]. ﴿أَنْ إِذا سَمِعْتُمْ آياتِ اللَّهِ﴾ أن is lightened from the heavy (anna), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), i.e. أنه; إذا is an adverb for future time, and the clause after it is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿يُكْفَرُ بِها﴾ an imperfect verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), and the preposition and its genitive noun take the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, and likewise ﴿وَيُسْتَهْزَأُ بِها﴾. ﴿فَلا تَقْعُدُوا مَعَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, to which the adverb of place معهم is attached; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿حَتَّى يَخُوضُوا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb تقعدوا before them; غيره is a naʿt. ﴿إِنَّكُمْ إِذاً مِثْلُهُمْ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; إذن is a particle of answer and requital that has no governing effect, and the clause gives the reason. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ جامِعُ الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ inna, its noun, its khabar and a muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْكافِرِينَ﴾ conjoined (ʿaṭf). ﴿فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾ the two are attached to جامع. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ a ḥāl, and the clause also gives the reason.

daas-irab:141-141.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَتَرَبَّصُونَ بِكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the relative noun is also a naʿt (adjective) of المنافقين, and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَإِنْ كانَ لَكُمْ فَتْحٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun لكم are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان, which is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and فتح is its noun. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of فتح. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. ﴿أَلَمْ نَكُنْ مَعَكُمْ؟﴾ the adverb of place is attached to an omitted khabar of نكن, whose noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; the hamza is for interrogation, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿وَإِنْ كانَ لِلْكافِرِينَ نَصِيبٌ قالُوا﴾ like ﴿فَإِنْ كانَ لَكُمْ فَتْحٌ﴾. ﴿أَلَمْ نَسْتَحْوِذْ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَنَمْنَعْكُمْ﴾ conjoined to نستحوذ. ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَاللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾ the two adverbs بينكم and يوم are attached to the verb يحكم, and the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الله; the clause ﴿فَاللَّهُ﴾ is resumptive; القيامة is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلَنْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لِلْكافِرِينَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ سَبِيلًا﴾ للكافرين: the two are attached to يجعل and they are the first object, and سبيلا is the second object; على المؤمنين: the two are attached to the verb or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from سبيلا; and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:142-143.t:
﴿إِنَّ الْمُنافِقِينَ يُخادِعُونَ اللَّهَ﴾
inna and its noun, and the verbal clause after it is its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَهُوَ خادِعُهُمْ﴾
a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِذا قامُوا إِلَى الصَّلاةِ قامُوا كُسالى﴾
the first clause قاموا is in the position of the genitive by annexation because it follows إذا, and the second clause قاموا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition; كسالى is a ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿يُراؤُنَ النَّاسَ﴾
an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَلا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾
conjoined to what precedes it; قليلا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and إلا is a particle of restriction. ﴿مُذَبْذَبِينَ﴾
a ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the adverb ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ after it is attached to it, and the demonstrative ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿لا إِلى هؤُلاءِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "not inclining to these". ﴿وَلا إِلى هؤُلاءِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ﴾ من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ, and [يضلل is] the jussive protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil and its object is omitted, i.e. "whomever Allah leads astray (يضلله)"; and the clause ﴿فَلَنْ تَجِدَ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لَهُ سَبِيلًا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl of سبيلا, and the two clauses of condition and apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

daas-irab:144-144.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لا تَتَّخِذُوا الْكافِرِينَ أَوْلِياءَ مِنْ دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); الكافرين is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and أولياء its second; من دون: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أولياء; المؤمنين is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ. ﴿أَتُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطاناً﴾ أن and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb تريدون, and the wāw is the fāʿil; لله: the two are attached to the verb تجعلوا and they are the first object, and سلطانا is the second object; عليكم: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾. ﴿مُبِيناً﴾ a naʿt. The clause ﴿لا تَتَّخِذُوا﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and the clause ﴿أَتُرِيدُونَ﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:145-146.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُنافِقِينَ فِي الدَّرْكِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; المنافقين is its noun. ﴿الْأَسْفَلِ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الدرك. ﴿وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُمْ نَصِيراً﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تجد and they are the first object, and نصيرا is the second object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تابُوا﴾ الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative by exception after إلا, and the clause تابوا is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَأَصْلَحُوا وَاعْتَصَمُوا بِاللَّهِ، وَأَخْلَصُوا دِينَهُمْ لِلَّهِ﴾ all of these are conjoined [Translator's note: the source has the typo كسل for كل]. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the adverb of place مع is attached to its omitted khabar; المؤمنين is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَسَوْفَ يُؤْتِ اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَجْراً عَظِيماً﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects, and عظيما is a naʿt.

daas-irab:147-147.t: ﴿ما يَفْعَلُ اللَّهُ بِعَذابِكُمْ﴾ ما is an interrogative noun; [يفعل is] an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its fāʿil (agent) [is the Name of Majesty]; the interrogative noun before it is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it: "If you are grateful and believe, then what would Allah do with your punishment?". ﴿وَآمَنْتُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿شاكِراً عَلِيماً﴾ khabar (predicate) of kāna.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ﴾: (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ), as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم الذين". It has also been said to be a badal (substitute) for (من كان); it has also been said to be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb: "أذم الذين" (I blame those who…). The clause (يبخلون) is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) it. ﴿وَيَكْتُمُونَ ما﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the relative noun is its mafʿūl bihi. The two clauses are maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿آتاهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: attached to (آتاهم), or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted second object. ﴿وَأَعْتَدْنا لِلْكافِرِينَ عَذاباً مُهِيناً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; (نا) is its fāʿil, (عذابا) its mafʿūl bihi, and (مهينا) a naʿt (adjective). The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:38-39.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: the relative noun is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it; the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رِئاءَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ﴾: the clause is maʿṭūf to what precedes it; (لا) is negating and has no governing effect. ﴿وَلا بِالْيَوْمِ﴾: conjoined to (الله). ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَمَنْ يَكُنِ الشَّيْطانُ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb and its noun (ism); (من) is a jussive conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (يكن) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿قَرِيناً﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (قرينا), or to (قرينا). ﴿فَساءَ قَرِيناً﴾: a rigid (jāmid) past verb expressing blame; (قرينا) is a tamyīz (specification), and the one specifically blamed is omitted, the implied form being: "فساء الشيطان قرينا" (an evil companion is Satan). The clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من). ﴿وَماذا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: (ماذا) is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; (عليهم) is attached to an omitted khabar. It is also permissible for (ما) to be an interrogative noun as mubtadaʾ and (ذا) a relative noun as its khabar, with the preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿لَوْ آمَنُوا﴾: (لو) is a conditional particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and the apodosis is omitted, the implied form being: "لو آمنوا فماذا عليهم". [Translator's note: the source says the verb is "in the position of the jussive" although لو is normally a non-jussive conditional particle; translated as written.] ﴿بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾: attached to the verb (آمنوا). ﴿وَأَنْفَقُوا﴾: conjoined to (آمنوا). ﴿مِمَّا رَزَقَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. The preposition and its genitive noun (مما) are attached to (أنفقوا). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ عَلِيماً﴾: (كان), its noun and its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (عليما). The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:40-42.t:
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: (إن), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism). ﴿لا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقالَ ذَرَّةٍ﴾: (لا) is negating, and an imperfect verb; (مثقال) is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "لا يظلم ظلما مثقال". It has also been said to be a second object, the first object being omitted, i.e. "لا يظلم أحدا مثقال". The clause is the khabar (predicate) of (إن), and (ذرة) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِنْ تَكُ﴾: (إن) is conditional, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with an implied (muqaddar) sukūn on the nūn, which was omitted for lightness, just as the wāw was omitted to prevent the meeting of two quiescent letters. Its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿حَسَنَةً﴾: its khabar. The clause (وإن تك) is resumptive. ﴿يُضاعِفْها﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿وَيُؤْتِ مِنْ لَدُنْهُ﴾: (لدنه) is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by (من); the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤت). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَجْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: naʿt.
﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (كيف) is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: "فكيف يصنعون ...؟" (how then will they act?); or in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as a khabar, the implied form being: "كيف حالهم" (how will their state be?). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, attached to the omitted verb or the omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿جِئْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (جئنا); (أمة) is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِشَهِيدٍ﴾: also attached to the verb. ﴿وَجِئْنا بِكَ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (جئنا). ﴿عَلى هؤُلاءِ﴾: attached to the ḥāl (شهيدا); the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: (يوم) is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time attached to (يود); (إذ) is an adverb for past time, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the tanwīn and the adverb [Translator's note: so in the source; normally it is the tanwīn alone that is said to compensate] compensate for the omitted clause, the implied form being: "يوم إذ جئنا يود الذين". ﴿يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause (يود) is resumptive. ﴿وَعَصَوُا الرَّسُولَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿لَوْ تُسَوَّى بِهِمُ الْأَرْضُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (لو) is a maṣdar-forming particle, which together with the verb after it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "تسوية" (being levelled). ﴿وَلا يَكْتُمُونَ اللَّهَ حَدِيثاً﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, (الله), the Name of Majesty, is its first object and (حديثا) its second object. The clause is maʿṭūf to the clause ﴿يَوَدُّ﴾.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (lā al-nāhiya), the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ سُكارى﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is circumstantial. ﴿حَتَّى تَعْلَمُوا ما تَقُولُونَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied (muḍmara) (أن) after (حتى) and the verb (تعلموا) is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تقربوا). The relative noun is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause (تقولون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلا جُنُباً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (جنبا) is a ḥāl, the implied form being "ولا تصلوا جنبا" (and do not pray while in a state of major impurity) or "لا تقربوا مواضع الصلاة جنبا" (do not approach the places of prayer in a state of major impurity); (لا) is negating. ﴿إِلَّا عابِرِي سَبِيلٍ﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (عابري) is the excepted, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. It has also been said that (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) and (عابري) is a ḥāl. ﴿حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلُوا﴾: like (حتى تعلموا); the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by (حتى), and the two are attached to (لا تقربوا). ﴿وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضى﴾: (كان), its noun and its khabar; the clause of (كان) is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوْ عَلى سَفَرٍ﴾: conjoined to (مرضى). ﴿أَوْ جاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (أحد). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنَ الْغائِطِ﴾: attached to (جاء). ﴿أَوْ لامَسْتُمُ النِّساءَ﴾: likewise conjoined. ﴿فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا ماءً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, with its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf to (كنتم). ﴿فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيداً﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is joined with the fāʾ. ﴿طَيِّباً﴾: naʿt. ﴿فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil. The clause is maʿṭūf to (تيمموا). It has also been said that the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿وَأَيْدِيكُمْ﴾: maʿṭūf, genitive with an implied (muqaddar) kasra. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: (إن), and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿كانَ عَفُوًّا﴾: (كان) and its khabar; its noun is omitted. [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun of كان is usually described as a latent pronoun.] ﴿غَفُوراً﴾: a second khabar.

daas-irab:44-45.t:
﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, (لم) is jussive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the omission of the weak letter because it is weak-final. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تر). ﴿أُوتُوا نَصِيباً مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾: a passive past verb; the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is the first object, and (نصيبا) is the second object. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (نصيبا). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿يَشْتَرُونَ الضَّلالَةَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is a mafʿūl bihi, considering (تر) to be a verb of the heart (cognition), not of sight.
﴿وَيُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَضِلُّوا﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar, "الضلالة" (going astray), is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّبِيلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi of (تضلوا). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَعْدائِكُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ وَلِيًّا﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (الله), the Name of Majesty, is the fāʿil of (كفى); (وليا) is a tamyīz (specification). The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ نَصِيراً﴾: conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿هادُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "من الذين هادوا قوم يحرفون" (among those who are Jews are a people who distort). ﴿عَنْ مَواضِعِهِ﴾: attached to (يحرفون). ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ سَمِعْنا وَعَصَيْنا﴾: (ويقولون) is conjoined to (يحرفون); (سمعنا) is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَعَصَيْنا﴾: conjoined; the two clauses are the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَاسْمَعْ﴾: a verb of supplication; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (سمعنا). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿مُسْمَعٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَراعِنا﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter; the fāʿil is "أنت" (you), and (نا) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is maʿṭūf to (اسمع). ﴿لَيًّا﴾: a ḥāl, accusative; it has also been said to be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ﴾: attached to (ليا). ﴿وَطَعْناً﴾: maʿṭūf to (ليا); the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it. ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ﴾: (لو) is a conditional particle and the wāw is resumptive; (أن) and its noun, and the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is its khabar. (أن) and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "لو ثبت قولهم" (had their saying been established). ﴿سَمِعْنا وَأَطَعْنا﴾: like (سمعنا وعصينا). ﴿وَاسْمَعْ﴾: like the preceding one. ﴿وَانْظُرْنا﴾: conjoined to (اسمع). ﴿لَكانَ خَيْراً لَهُمْ﴾: (كان) and its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَأَقْوَمَ﴾: conjoined to (خيرا). ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿بِكُفْرِهِمْ﴾: attached to (لعنهم); the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَلا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; (لا) is negating and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾: the excepted, accusative with the fatḥa, and (إلا) is a particle of exception. It has also been said to be a naʿt of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), with (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), i.e. "لا يؤمنون إلا إيمانا قليلا" (they do not believe except with a little belief).

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (الكتاب) is its object. ﴿آمِنُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِما نَزَّلْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا); the clause ﴿نَزَّلْنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مصدقا). ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila, i.e. "للذي وجد معكم" (to what is found with you). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾: attached to (آمنوا). ﴿أَنْ نَطْمِسَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وُجُوهاً﴾: the object of (نطمس). ﴿فَنَرُدَّها﴾: conjoined to (نطمس); the hāʾ is its object. ﴿عَلى أَدْبارِها﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "نردها ناكصة" (We turn them back reversed). ﴿أَوْ نَلْعَنَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to (نردها). ﴿كَما لَعَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; (ما) is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the kāf. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: "نلعنهم لعنا كلعننا أصحاب السبت" (We curse them with a cursing like Our cursing of the people of the Sabbath). ﴿أَصْحابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿السَّبْتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا﴾: (كان) and its noun, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; (مفعولا) is its khabar (predicate). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined).

daas-irab:48-50.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَغْفِرُ أَنْ يُشْرَكَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from the passive, accusative imperfect verb (يشرك) and the subjunctive-governing (أن) is in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb (يغفر). The clause (يغفر) is the khabar (predicate) of (إن), and (الله), the Name of Majesty, is its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يشرك). ﴿وَيَغْفِرُ ما دُونَ ذلِكَ﴾: (ما) is a relative noun, the object of (يغفر); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to Allah. (دون) is an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; (ذلك) is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The clause is resumptive. ﴿لِمَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (يغفر); the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَمَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (من) is a jussive conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is the two clauses of the condition. (يشرك) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), and the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it. ﴿فَقَدِ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿افْتَرى إِثْماً عَظِيماً﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; (عظيما) is a naʿt (adjective). The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: (تر) is an imperfect verb, jussive by the omission of the weak letter; the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it. ﴿يُزَكُّونَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بَلِ اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿يُزَكِّي مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause (يزكي) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله). ﴿وَلا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا﴾: (لا) is negating, and a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (فتيلا) stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "لا يظلمون ظلما قليلا" (they are not wronged even a little). The clause ﴿لا يُظْلَمُونَ ... ﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to an omitted clause whose implied form is: "يحاسبون بعدل ولا يظلمون" (they are reckoned with justice and are not wronged). ﴿انْظُرْ كَيْفَ﴾: an imperative verb, and the interrogative noun is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and (الكذب) is its object. ﴿وَكَفى بِهِ﴾: a past verb; the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition and the hāʾ is its object; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun explained by what follows it, i.e. "كفى الإثم" (the sin suffices). [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere in this book the noun after the redundant bāʾ of كفى is parsed as its fāʿil.] ﴿إِثْماً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿مُبِيناً﴾: naʿt. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيباً مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾: see its i'rab at verse no. 44. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause (يؤمنون), and the clause (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿هؤُلاءِ أَهْدى﴾: a demonstrative indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (أهدى) is its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) (أهدى); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:52-54.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾. ﴿لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (من) is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَلْعَنِ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) with sukūn, given a kasra to avoid the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُ نَصِيراً﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نصيرا). ﴿نَصِيراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَمْ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ﴾: (أم) is a conjunction; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and (نصيب) is a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنَ الْمُلْكِ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (نصيب). ﴿فَإِذاً﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), i.e. "لو كان لهم نصيب" (if they had a share); (إذن) is a particle of response. ﴿لا يُؤْتُونَ النَّاسَ نَقِيراً﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; (لا) is negating. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ النَّاسَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause (أم لهم). ﴿عَلى ما آتاهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of (ما). The preposition and its genitive noun (على ما) are attached to (يحسدون). ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: attached to (آتاهم). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ is for consequence (tafrīʿ). ﴿آتَيْنا آلَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a foreign proper name. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُمْ مُلْكاً عَظِيماً﴾: like (آتينا آل إبراهيم); the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:148-149.t: ﴿لا يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ الْجَهْرَ بِالسُّوءِ﴾ يحب is an imperfect verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent), الجهر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) الجهر; لا is negative. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْلِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from السوء. ﴿إِلَّا مَنْ ظُلِمَ﴾ من is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative by exception, and إلا is a particle of exception; it was also said that it is a particle of restriction, in which case the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation, i.e. "except the speaking aloud of one who has been wronged" (إلا جهر من ظلم). ظلم is a past verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ سَمِيعاً عَلِيماً﴾ kāna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun, and سميعا and عليما are its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ تُبْدُوا خَيْراً﴾ تبدوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and خيرا its object. ﴿أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ، أَوْ تَعْفُوا عَنْ سُوءٍ﴾ conjoined; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then Allah knows it" (فالله يعلمه); and the clause ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ عَفُوًّا قَدِيراً﴾ its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:150-151.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ﴾ the relative noun is in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna, and the verbal clause has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُفَرِّقُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb after it is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يريدون, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَرُسُلِهِ﴾ conjoined, and the clause is conjoined to يكفرون. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ نُؤْمِنُ بِبَعْضٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نؤمن, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech), and the clause of saying is conjoined. ﴿وَنَكْفُرُ بِبَعْضٍ﴾ conjoined to ﴿نُؤْمِنُ﴾. ﴿وَيُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذُوا بَيْنَ ذلِكَ سَبِيلًا﴾ like the one before it; the demonstrative ذلك is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and سبيلا is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هُمُ﴾ an attached pronoun [Translator's note: so in the source; هم is in fact a detached (munfaṣil) pronoun] in the position of the nominative as a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكافِرُونَ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿هُمُ الْكافِرُونَ﴾ is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿حَقًّا﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَأَعْتَدْنا لِلْكافِرِينَ عَذاباً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿مُهِيناً﴾ a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna in His saying: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ..

daas-irab:152-153.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ﴾ the relative noun الذين is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, the two being attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقُوا بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), to which the adverb after it is attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد, and the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿أُولئِكَ سَوْفَ يُؤْتِيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its two objects, the fāʿil being "he" (هو); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, and the clause أولئك is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿يَسْئَلُكَ أَهْلُ الْكِتابِ أَنْ تُنَزِّلَ﴾ the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يسأل, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb after it is the second object. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to تنزل, and ﴿كِتاباً﴾ is its object. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of كتابا. ﴿فَقَدْ سَأَلُوا مُوسى أَكْبَرَ مِنْ ذلِكَ﴾ سألوا is a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) أكبر; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied non-jussivizing condition after the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined to سألوا, or explicative. ﴿أَرِنَا اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً﴾ أرنا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, the fāʿil being "you" (أنت); نا is the first object and ﴿اللَّهَ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is the second object. ﴿جَهْرَةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "openly" (مجاهرة), or standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "by direct sight" (مشاهدة); and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ بِظُلْمِهِمْ﴾ a past verb; the hāʾ is its object and الصاعقة its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the clause is conjoined to سألوا. ﴿ثُمَّ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ما جاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّناتُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the second object is omitted, its implied form being: "they took the calf as a god" (اتخذوا العجل إلا ها [Translator's note: the source's «إلا ها» is evidently a misprint for إلهًا "a god"]); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اتخذوا; and the interpreted maṣdar after ما جاءتهم is in the position of the genitive by annexation, the implied form being: "after the coming of" (من بعد مجيء). ﴿فَعَفَوْنا عَنْ ذلِكَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَآتَيْنا مُوسى سُلْطاناً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects. ﴿مُبِيناً﴾ a naʿt, and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:154-154.t: ﴿وَرَفَعْنا فَوْقَهُمُ الطُّورَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the adverb فوق is attached to (mutaʿalliq) this verb. ﴿بِمِيثاقِهِمْ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿وَقُلْنا لَهُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْبابَ سُجَّداً﴾ نا is the fāʿil of قلنا, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قلنا; the clause ﴿ادْخُلُوا الْبابَ﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿سُجَّداً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقُلْنا لَهُمُ﴾ conjoined to the first قلنا. ﴿لا تَعْدُوا فِي السَّبْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun في السبت are attached to this verb; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَأَخَذْنا مِنْهُمْ مِيثاقاً غَلِيظاً﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; نا is its fāʿil and ميثاقا its object; غليظا is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:155-155.t: ﴿فَبِما نَقْضِهِمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is redundant (zāʾida); نقضهم is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, its implied form being: "We did to them what We did because of their breaking". ﴿مِيثاقَهُمْ﴾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun) نقضهم. ﴿وَكُفْرِهِمْ بِآياتِ اللَّهِ﴾ conjoined to نقضهم, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar كفر. ﴿وَقَتْلِهِمُ الْأَنْبِياءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ﴾ الأنبياء is the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar قتل, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿وَقَوْلِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to قتلهم. ﴿قُلُوبُنا غُلْفٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿بَلْ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْها﴾ بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); [طبع is] a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِكُفْرِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to طبع, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا يُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; قليلا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); إلا is a particle of restriction; and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:156-158.t: ﴿وَبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to ﴿فَبِما نَقْضِهِمْ﴾. ﴿عَلى مَرْيَمَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) قولهم. ﴿بُهْتاناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of this maṣdar. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَقَوْلِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to قولهم before it. ﴿إِنَّا قَتَلْنَا الْمَسِيحَ﴾ inna, with نا as its noun, and the verbal clause after it is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إِنَّا﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿عِيسَى﴾ badal (substitute) from المسيح. ﴿ابْنَ﴾ a naʿt of, or badal from, عيسى. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because of being a proper name and feminine. ﴿رَسُولَ اللَّهِ﴾ badal from المسيح, or a naʿt; الله: the Name of Majesty is a muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما قَتَلُوهُ﴾ a past verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and ما is negative. ﴿وَما صَلَبُوهُ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَلكِنْ شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the past passive verb before them, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ﴾ inna, with the relative noun as its noun, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause); فيه: the two are attached to اختلفوا; and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَفِي شَكٍّ مِنْهُ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to the omitted khabar of inna; منه: the two are attached to شك. ﴿ما لَهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ﴾ لهم: the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; به: the two are attached to علم; من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and علم is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿اتِّباعَ﴾ a disjoined excepted noun (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿الظَّنِّ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما قَتَلُوهُ يَقِيناً﴾ ما is negative; a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; يقينا is an accusative ḥāl, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بَلْ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ﴾ بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ are attached to رفعه; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزاً حَكِيماً﴾ kāna, its noun and its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:159-160.t:
﴿وَإِنْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "and there is no one of the People of the Book" (وما أحد من أهل الكتاب); إن is negative and has no governing effect, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ﴾ يؤمنن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection to the heavy nūn of emphasis, the fāʿil (agent) being "he" (هو); the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath, and the clause is the response to the oath with no grammatical position; إلا is a particle of restriction. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يؤمنن, and likewise the adverb ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ is attached to the verb. ﴿مَوْتِهِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ يَكُونُ﴾ the adverb يوم is attached to the khabar ﴿شَهِيداً﴾, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾; the clause is conjoined, and the noun of يكون is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being:
"he" (هو). ﴿فَبِظُلْمٍ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and the two are attached to حرمنا. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ظلم, and the clause ﴿هادُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause); the clause ﴿حَرَّمْنا عَلَيْهِمْ طَيِّباتٍ﴾ is resumptive: حرمنا is a past verb and its fāʿil, طيبات is its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حرمنا. ﴿أُحِلَّتْ لَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt. ﴿وَبِصَدِّهِمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ conjoined to بظلم; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) صدهم; الله: the Name of Majesty is a muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "many people" (أناسا كثيرا), or standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:55-56.t: ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of consequence (tafrīʿ); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنَ بِهِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the past verb (آمن); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ صَدَّ عَنْهُ﴾: conjoined to (منهم من آمن به). ﴿وَكَفى بِجَهَنَّمَ سَعِيراً﴾: a past verb; (جهنم) is its fāʿil (agent) and (سعيرا) a tamyīz (specification); the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition on the fāʿil. The clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb (كفروا); the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿سَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِمْ﴾: (سوف) is a particle of futurity; (نصليهم) is an imperfect verb and its first object. ﴿ناراً﴾: its second object. ﴿كُلَّما﴾: an adverb of time attached to the apodosis (بدلناهم). ﴿نَضِجَتْ جُلُودُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَدَّلْناهُمْ جُلُوداً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects. ﴿غَيْرَها﴾: naʿt (adjective). The clause is a naʿt of (نارا), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in (نصليهم). ﴿لِيَذُوقُوا الْعَذابَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: its object. The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (بدلناهم). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَزِيزاً حَكِيماً﴾: (إن), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (كان) and its two khabars; the clause is the khabar of (إن), and the noun of (كان) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.

daas-irab:57-58.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (آمنوا) is its ṣila (relative clause), and the clause (عملوا الصالحات) is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ﴾: an imperfect verb and its two objects; the sīn is for futurity. The clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); (الأنهار) is its fāʿil (agent). The clause is a naʿt (adjective) of (جنات). ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it, as is the adverb of time ﴿أَبَداً﴾. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿أَزْواجٌ﴾. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl of (أزواج). ﴿مُطَهَّرَةٌ﴾: naʿt of (أزواج). The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَنُدْخِلُهُمْ ظِلًّا ظَلِيلًا﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is its first object, (ظلا) the second object, and (ظليلا) a naʿt. The clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ﴾: (إن), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is its khabar. ﴿أَنْ تُؤَدُّوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (يأمركم); the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الْأَماناتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿إِلى أَهْلِها﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl of (الأمانات). ﴿وَإِذا حَكَمْتُمْ﴾: (إذا) is an adverb for future time, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being: "يأمركم" (He commands you). ﴿حَكَمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (حكمتم). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْ تَحْكُمُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by the omission of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is its fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and it is maʿṭūf to the first maṣdar. ﴿بِالْعَدْلِ﴾: attached to (تحكموا). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُمْ بِهِ﴾: (نعم) is a past verb expressing praise; (ما) is a complete (tāmma) indefinite noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun explained by (ما). It has also been said that the fāʿil is (ما), it being a relative noun. (يعظكم) is an imperfect verb and its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause (يعظكم) is a naʿt of (ما). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ سَمِيعاً بَصِيراً﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and its fāʿil (agent); the Name of Majesty is its object. ﴿وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَأُولِي﴾: also conjoined to (الله), accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; the nūn was dropped for the annexation. ﴿الْأَمْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أولي). ﴿فَإِنْ تَنازَعْتُمْ فِي شَيْءٍ﴾: (إن) is conditional, and a past verb indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it. The clause is resumptive. ﴿فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object. ﴿وَالرَّسُولِ﴾: conjoined to (الله). The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: (كان) and its noun, and the clause ﴿تُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كنتم). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: attached to (تؤمنون). ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿ذلِكَ خَيْرٌ﴾: a demonstrative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (خير) is its khabar. ﴿وَأَحْسَنُ﴾: conjoined to (خير). ﴿تَأْوِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). The clause is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "إن كنتم تؤمنون فردوه" (if you believe, then refer it).

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: its i'rab is as in verse 51. ﴿يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (أن). The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن), its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of (يزعمون). ﴿بِما﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the passive verb ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾. [Translator's note: so in the source; (بما) is ordinarily attached to (آمنوا), and (ما) is the relative noun whose ṣila is (أنزل).] ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَما أُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾: conjoined to (ما أنزل إليك). ﴿يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَتَحاكَمُوا﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause (يريدون) is circumstantial. ﴿إِلَى الطَّاغُوتِ﴾: attached to (يتحاكموا). ﴿وَقَدْ أُمِرُوا﴾: a passive past verb; the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil; (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنْ يَكْفُرُوا بِهِ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb (أمروا). ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to (يكفروا). ﴿وَيُرِيدُ الشَّيْطانُ أَنْ يُضِلَّهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is the mafʿūl bihi. The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿ضَلالًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿بَعِيداً﴾: naʿt (adjective).

daas-irab:61-62.t: ﴿وَإِذا قِيلَ لَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا) is an adverb for the future; (لهم) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the passive verb (قيل). ﴿تَعالَوْا إِلى ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (تعالوا), and the clause (أنزل الله) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَإِلَى الرَّسُولِ﴾: conjoined to (ما أنزل). The clause (تعالوا) is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿رَأَيْتَ الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَصُدُّونَ عَنْكَ صُدُوداً﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil; (صدودا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause is circumstantial, or a second object if (رأيت) is a verb of the heart (cognition), not of sight. ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (كيف) is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, attached to the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَصابَتْهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ﴾: a past verb; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and (مصيبة) is its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾: attached to (أصابتهم). ﴿قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما). ﴿ثُمَّ جاؤُكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (أصابتهم). ﴿يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the wāw is its fāʿil. The clause is circumstantial. ﴿إِنْ أَرَدْنا﴾: a past verb, and (نا) is its fāʿil; (إن) is negating and has no governing effect. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿إِحْساناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَتَوْفِيقاً﴾: conjoined. The clause is the response to the oath in His saying (يحلفون), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:63-64.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, its khabar (predicate). ﴿يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ ما فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the relative noun (ما) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين). ﴿فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the imperative verb before them; the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, because the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿وَعِظْهُمْ﴾: the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it. ﴿وَقُلْ لَهُمْ﴾: likewise conjoined. ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: attached to (بليغا). ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿بَلِيغاً﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَما أَرْسَلْنا مِنْ رَسُولٍ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; (من) is redundant (zāʾida), and (رسول) is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi; (ما) is negating. The clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِيُطاعَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (أرسلنا). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾: attached to (يطاع). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (لو) is a non-jussive conditional; (أنهم) is (أن) and its noun. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to the verb (جاؤوك). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. (أن) and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ولو صدق مجيئهم" (had their coming truly occurred). ﴿جاؤُكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of (أن). ﴿لَوَجَدُوا اللَّهَ تَوَّاباً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, and the lām is the connective (rābiṭa) for this condition. ﴿رَحِيماً﴾: naʿt.

daas-irab:65-66.t: ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and (لا) is a connective (ṣila) particle. ﴿وَرَبِّكَ﴾: the wāw is the wāw of oath; (ربك) is a noun genitive by the wāw, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb (أقسم) (I swear). ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and (لا) is negating. The clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muḍmara) (أن) after (حتى); the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (يؤمنون). ﴿فِيما شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: (بينهم) is an adverb of place attached to (شجر); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun (فيما) are attached to (يحكموك). ﴿ثُمَّ لا يَجِدُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجاً﴾: an imperfect verb, conjoined to (يحكموك), accusative; the wāw is its fāʿil and (حرجا) its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to this verb. ﴿مِمَّا قَضَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun (مما) are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (حرجا). ﴿وَيُسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيماً﴾: conjoined to (يجدوا); the wāw is the fāʿil, and (تسليما) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (لو) is a non-jussive conditional. ﴿أَنَّا﴾: (أن) and its noun. ﴿كَتَبْنا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and (نا) is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of (أن). ﴿أَنِ اقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; (أن) is an explicative particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: so in the source; an explicative أن does not usually form a maṣdar.] ﴿أَوِ اخْرُجُوا مِنْ دِيارِكُمْ﴾: the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿ما فَعَلُوهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; (ما) is negating. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of (لو). ﴿إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ﴾: (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (قليل) is a badal (substitute) for the wāw in (فعلوه). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt of (قليل). ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ فَعَلُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of (أن), and the clause (أنهم) is maʿṭūf. ﴿ما يُوعَظُونَ بِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb is passive, so the wāw would be its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent)]; the clause is the ṣila of (ما), and (ما) is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكانَ خَيْراً لَهُمْ﴾: (كان) and its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿وَأَشَدَّ﴾ ﴿تَثْبِيتاً﴾: conjoined to (خيرا), and (تثبيتا) is a tamyīz (specification). The clause (لكان ...) is the apodosis of (لو), with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source text reads «جواب لولا محل لها», evidently a run-together of «جواب لو لا محل لها»; translated accordingly.]

daas-irab:67-69.t: ﴿وَإِذاً﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذن) is a particle of response and requital, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَآتَيْناهُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "لو أنهم أطاعوا لآتيناهم" (had they obeyed, We would have given them); (آتيناهم) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنَّا﴾: (لدن) is indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by (من); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿أَجْراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَلَهَدَيْناهُمْ صِراطاً مُسْتَقِيماً﴾: like (لآتيناهم أجرا عظيما); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) with sukūn, given a kasra to avoid the meeting of two quiescent letters; the Name of Majesty is its object. The conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the protasis and its apodosis are its khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; (مع) is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar; the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the clause (أنعم الله عليهم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause (فأولئك) is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ﴾: a noun genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَداءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَحَسُنَ أُولئِكَ رَفِيقاً﴾: a past verb, and the demonstrative is its fāʿil; (رفيقا) is a tamyīz (specification).

daas-irab:70-71.t: ﴿ذلِكَ الْفَضْلُ مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الفضل) is a badal (substitute), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). It is also permissible to parse (الفضل) as the khabar. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ عَلِيماً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a tamyīz (specification); the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). The clause is resumptive. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿خُذُوا حِذْرَكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَانْفِرُوا ثُباتٍ﴾: (انفروا) is an imperative indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; (ثبات) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَوِ انْفِرُوا جَمِيعاً﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, and it is like it.

daas-irab:72-73.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْكُمْ لَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (إن) is a particle resembling the verb; (منكم) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); in (لمن), the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the relative noun is the noun (ism) of (إن). ﴿لَيُبَطِّئَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath, i.e. "أقسم ليبطئن" (I swear he will surely lag behind); (يبطئن) is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis. The clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the implied oath. ﴿فَإِنْ أَصابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its object and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. The clause ﴿قالَ﴾ has no grammatical position, not being joined with the fāʾ. The clause ﴿قَدْ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ﴾ is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (أنعم). ﴿لَمْ أَكُنْ مَعَهُمْ شَهِيداً﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and (شهيدا) is its khabar, to which the adverb (معهم) is attached. The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَلَئِنْ أَصابَكُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) is a jussive conditional; (أصاب) is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and the kāf is its object. ﴿فَضْلٌ﴾: fāʿil, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ are attached. ﴿لَيَقُولَنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the oath, like (ليبطئن); the clause is the response to an oath, with no grammatical position, and it suffices in place of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿كَأَنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُ مَوَدَّةٌ﴾: (يكن) is a defective imperfect verb, jussive; (بينكم) is an adverb attached to its omitted khabar, and (بينهم) is conjoined [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse reads (وبينه)]; (مودة) is its postponed noun. The clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of (كأن), lightened from the heavy form, whose noun is an omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The clause is parenthetical. ﴿يا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ مَعَهُمْ﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle, and the one addressed is omitted, its implied form being: "يا قوم" (O people); it has also been said that it is for drawing attention (tanbīh). (ليتني): (ليت) and its noun, and the nūn is for protection (wiqāya). (كنت معهم): a defective past verb; the tāʾ is its noun, and the adverb is attached to its omitted khabar. The clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of (ليت). ﴿فَأَفُوزَ فَوْزاً عَظِيماً﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the fāʾ of causation (sababiyya), and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and its naʿt (adjective); the fāʿil is "أنا" (I).

daas-irab:161-162.t:
﴿وَأَخْذِهِمُ الرِّبَوا﴾ conjoined to صدهم; الربا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun) أخذ. ﴿وَقَدْ نُهُوا عَنْهُ﴾ a past verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl); the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) after the wāw of circumstance, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿وَأَكْلِهِمْ أَمْوالَ النَّاسِ﴾ conjoined to وأخذهم.. ﴿بِالْباطِلِ﴾ the two are attached to the maṣdar أكلهم. ﴿وَأَعْتَدْنا لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ اعتدنا is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and نا is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl from الكافرين. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ its object. ﴿أَلِيماً﴾ a naʿt (adjective), and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿حَرَّمْنا﴾. ﴿لكِنِ الرَّاسِخُونَ فِي الْعِلْمِ﴾ الراسخون is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, and the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in الراسخون. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ conjoined to الراسخون. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ بِما أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ﴾ بما: the two are attached to the verb يؤمنون, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ الراسخون. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to the passive verb أنزل, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun before it. ﴿وَما أُنْزِلَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَالْمُقِيمِينَ الصَّلاةَ﴾ المقيمين is an accusative mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "I praise" (أمدح); الصلاة is the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar المقيمين [Translator's note: so in the source; المقيمين is an active participle, not a maṣdar]; the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْمُؤْتُونَ الزَّكاةَ﴾ conjoined to ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿سَنُؤْتِيهِمْ أَجْراً﴾ an imperfect verb and its two objects; the sīn is for the future, and the fāʿil is "we" (نحن). ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ a naʿt; the clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:163-163.t:
﴿إِنَّا أَوْحَيْنا إِلَيْكَ﴾ أوحينا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun إليك are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and نا is its noun. ﴿كَما أَوْحَيْنا﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); ما is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from maṣdariyya ما and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by annexation; the implied form is: "We revealed to you a revelation like Our revelation to Nūḥ". It is also permissible to parse the kāf as a preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted naʿt of an implied mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿إِلى نُوحٍ﴾ the two are attached to أوحينا. ﴿وَالنَّبِيِّينَ﴾ conjoined to نوح. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾ the clause is conjoined to the first أوحينا. ﴿إِلى إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ a noun genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a foreign proper name, diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf); and likewise the conjoined names ﴿وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْباطِ وَعِيسى..﴾ etc. ﴿وَآتَيْنا داوُدَ زَبُوراً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is conjoined to the first أوحينا.

daas-irab:164-165.t: ﴿وَرُسُلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "We sent" (أرسلنا). ﴿قَدْ قَصَصْناهُمْ عَلَيْكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi, and عليك: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by من; the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَرُسُلًا لَمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ﴾ conjoined; the clause ﴿قَصَصْناهُمْ﴾ is a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسى﴾ كلم is a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, and موسى is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَكْلِيماً﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause is resumptive. And ﴿رُسُلًا﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the ﴿رُسُلًا﴾ before it, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa. ﴿مُبَشِّرِينَ﴾ a naʿt of رسلا, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿وَمُنْذِرِينَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿لِئَلَّا﴾ the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl); أن is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; لا is negative. ﴿يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى اللَّهِ حُجَّةٌ﴾ للناس: the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb (fiʿl nāqiṣ) يكون; على الله: the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, the two being attached to the omitted khabar; حجة is its noun; and أن with the incomplete verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مبشرين or منذرين. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to an omitted naʿt of حجة. ﴿الرُّسُلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزاً حَكِيماً﴾ kāna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun, and عزيزا and حكيما are its two khabars.

daas-irab:166-169.t: ﴿لكِنِ اللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ بِما أَنْزَلَ إِلَيْكَ﴾ the clause يشهد is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الله, Mighty and Majestic; the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ما; the preposition and its genitive noun بما are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يشهد; إليك: the two are attached to أنزل. ﴿أَنْزَلَهُ بِعِلْمِهِ﴾ the clause is explicative of the clause before it. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ يَشْهَدُونَ﴾ like الله يشهد, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيداً﴾ a past verb, the Name of Majesty as fāʿil (agent), and a tamyīz (specification); the bāʾ is added (redundant) on the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ inna, with the relative noun as its noun, and the verbal clause is the ṣila; the clause ﴿وَصَدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿قَدْ ضَلُّوا ضَلالًا بَعِيداً﴾ ضلوا is a past verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); بعيدا is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَظَلَمُوا﴾ like the previous verse. ﴿لَمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, with the Name of Majesty as its noun; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the verb يغفر and the implied أن after the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of يكن. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يغفر. ﴿وَلا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ طَرِيقاً﴾ conjoined to ليغفر لهم; طريقا is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and لا is negative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿طَرِيقَ﴾ excepted by إلا, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because of being a proper name and foreign. ﴿خالِدِينَ فِيها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun فيها are attached to the ḥāl (circumstantial) before them, and likewise the adverb ﴿أَبَداً﴾. ﴿وَكانَ ذلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيراً﴾ كان is an incomplete past verb; the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, the two being attached to the khabar يسيرا; and the demonstrative is in the position of the nominative as the noun of kāna. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:170-170.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جاءَكُمُ الرَّسُولُ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ جاءكم is a past verb and its object; الرسول is its fāʿil (agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) this verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحق, and the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿فَآمِنُوا خَيْراً لَكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); آمنوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is its fāʿil; خيرا is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted incomplete verb, the implied form being: "belief will be better for you" (يكن الإيمان خيرا لكم); it was also said that it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun): "a belief better for you"; لكم: the two are attached to خيرا; and the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition.
﴿وَإِنْ تَكْفُرُوا﴾ the jussive protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its fāʿil; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then your disbelief is upon you". ﴿فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; لله: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, the two being attached to its omitted khabar; في السموات: the two are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). The clauses ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ and ﴿وَإِنْ تَكْفُرُوا﴾ are both resumptive.

daas-irab:171-171.t: ﴿يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ لا تَغْلُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ﴾ يا is the vocative particle; أهل is the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb); الكتاب is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); لا is the jussivizing lā of prohibition; تغلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَلا تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to the verb; إلا is a particle of restriction; الحق is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّمَا الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ﴾ عيسى is a badal (substitute) from the mubtadaʾ (subject) before it, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma; ابن is a naʿt (adjective) or badal; مريم is a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because of being a proper name and feminine. ﴿رَسُولُ اللَّهِ﴾ رسول is the khabar (predicate), and the Name of Majesty is a muḍāf ilayhi; إنما is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) particle, and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿وَكَلِمَتُهُ﴾ conjoined to رسول. ﴿أَلْقاها إِلى مَرْيَمَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَرُوحٌ مِنْهُ﴾ conjoined; منه: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of روح. ﴿فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ﴾ an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied non-jussivizing condition, because it comes after the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). ﴿وَلا تَقُولُوا ثَلاثَةٌ﴾ ثلاثة is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "our gods are three" (آلهتنا ثلاثة); the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech), and the verbal clause is conjoined. ﴿انْتَهُوا خَيْراً لَكُمْ﴾ the i'rab of something similar has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿إِنَّمَا اللَّهُ إِلهٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ and إله the khabar; إنما is kāffa wa-makfūfa. ﴿واحِدٌ﴾ a naʿt, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of a verb that must be omitted. ﴿أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ﴾ له: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of يكون, and ولد is its noun; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the incomplete verb is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) سبحانه, i.e. "glory be to Him from His having a son". ﴿لَهُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ له: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما; في السموات: the two are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا﴾ this clause and the one before it are both resumptive.

daas-irab:172-173.t:
[Translator's note: in the source the Quranic phrases in the first part of this entry are damaged: the opening bracket and first letter of each are lost and the closing bracket appears as «»» (e.g. «َنْ يَسْتَنْكِفَ الْمَسِيحُ»» for ﴿لَنْ يَسْتَنْكِفَ الْمَسِيحُ﴾). They are given below in their complete Quranic form within ﴿…﴾.]
﴿لَنْ يَسْتَنْكِفَ الْمَسِيحُ﴾
يستنكف is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ يَكُونَ عَبْداً﴾
يكون is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, the implied form being: "he will not disdain being a servant" (لن يستنكف عن كونه عبدا); عبدا is the khabar (predicate) of يكون. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾
the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the two being attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of عبدا. ﴿وَلَا الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾
conjoined to المسيح. ﴿الْمُقَرَّبُونَ﴾ a naʿt. ﴿وَمَنْ يَسْتَنْكِفْ عَنْ عِبادَتِهِ﴾
يستنكف is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by من, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it, and its fāʿil is latent; the conditional noun من is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيَسْتَكْبِرْ﴾
conjoined. ﴿فَسَيَحْشُرُهُمْ إِلَيْهِ جَمِيعاً﴾
