the imperfect verb is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with its object, and its fāʿil is latent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; جميعا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ أما is a particle of condition, detailing and emphasis; the fāʾ is for consequence (tafrīʿ); the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its two objects, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun; the fāʾ occurs in the response to أما. ﴿وَيَزِيدُهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ conjoined to the predicative clause before it. ﴿وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اسْتَنْكَفُوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فَيُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذاباً أَلِيماً﴾ the clause is conjoined; عذابا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), أليما a naʿt. ﴿وَلا يَجِدُونَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّا﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; لهم: the two are attached to وليا; من دون: the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَلا نَصِيراً﴾ conjoined, and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:174-175.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿قَدْ جاءَكُمْ بُرْهانٌ﴾ a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of برهان. ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا إِلَيْكُمْ نُوراً﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; نورا is the mafʿūl bihi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزلنا. ﴿مُبِيناً﴾ a naʿt, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَاعْتَصَمُوا بِهِ فَسَيُدْخِلُهُمْ فِي رَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ﴾ like ﴿فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا﴾; the preposition and its genitive noun منه are attached to an omitted naʿt of رحمة; in the clause ﴿فَسَيُدْخِلُهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), [يدخل is] an imperfect verb with its object, the sīn is a particle of the future, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الذين. ﴿وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَيْهِ صِراطاً﴾ يهدي is an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the hāʾ is its first object and صراطا the second object. ﴿مُسْتَقِيماً﴾ a naʿt, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:176-176.t: ﴿يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الْكَلالَةِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يفتيكم; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the Name of Majesty الله, and the nominal clause ﴿اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿إِنِ امْرُؤٌ هَلَكَ﴾ إن is conditional; امرؤ is the fāʿil of an omitted verb explained by what comes after it, and the clause ﴿هَلَكَ﴾ is explicative. ﴿لَيْسَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ﴾ laysa, with ولد as its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar, and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of امرؤ. ﴿وَلَهُ أُخْتٌ﴾ أخت is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَها نِصْفُ ما تَرَكَ﴾ لها: the two are attached to the omitted khabar; نصف is the mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause ﴿تَرَكَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), and the relative noun ما is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَهُوَ يَرِثُها﴾ the clause يرثها is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَها وَلَدٌ﴾ يكن and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "then he inherits from her" (فهو يرثها). ﴿فَإِنْ كانَتَا اثْنَتَيْنِ﴾ كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, with its noun and its khabar; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلَهُمَا الثُّلُثانِ مِمَّا تَرَكَ﴾ like فلها نصف ما ترك; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الثلثان. The clause is also in the position of the jussive. ﴿وَإِنْ كانُوا إِخْوَةً﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; إن is a jussivizing conditional particle, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رِجالًا وَنِساءً﴾ رجالا is a badal (substitute) from إخوة, accusative (manṣūb), and نساء is conjoined. ﴿فَلِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ مثل; حظ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الأنثيين is a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is dual; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of إن. ﴿يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَضِلُّوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by annexation, on the assumption of a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) before it: "out of dislike of your going astray" (كراهة ضلالكم) or "so that you not go astray" (لعدم ضلالكم); the preposition and its genitive noun لكم are attached to يبين, and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e. "Allah makes that clear to you lest you go astray". ﴿وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun بكل are attached to the khabar عليم, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:74-74.t: ﴿فَلْيُقاتِلْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent). The clause is resumptive. ﴿يَشْرُونَ الْحَياةَ الدُّنْيا بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, with its fāʿil and its object; (الدنيا) is a naʿt (adjective). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَمَنْ يُقاتِلْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; (من) is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (الله), the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَيُقْتَلْ﴾: a passive imperfect, conjoined to (يقاتل). ﴿أَوْ يَغْلِبْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾: a particle of futurity, and the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿نُؤْتِيهِ أَجْراً﴾: an imperfect and its two objects; its fāʿil is "نحن" (We). ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: naʿt. The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:75-75.t: ﴿وَما لَكُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (ما); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تُقاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: (لا) is negating, and an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; (الله), the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ﴾: conjoined to (الله), i.e. "وخلاص المستضعفين" (and the deliverance of the oppressed). ﴿مِنَ الرِّجالِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالنِّساءِ وَالْوِلْدانِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective), and the clause ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿رَبَّنا أَخْرِجْنا مِنْ هذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ﴾: (أخرجنا) is a verb of supplication and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil is "أنت" (You), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; (القرية) is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, genitive with the kasra; (ربنا) is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb) by the omitted vocative particle. The clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الظَّالِمِ﴾: naʿt. ﴿أَهْلُها﴾: the fāʿil of (الظالم). ﴿وَاجْعَلْ لَنا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb of supplication before them, and they are in the position of the accusative as the first object. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْكَ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾, the second object of (اجعل). And likewise: ﴿وَاجْعَلْ لَنا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ نَصِيراً﴾.

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يُقاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُقاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ الطَّاغُوتِ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿فَقاتِلُوا أَوْلِياءَ الشَّيْطانِ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; (الشيطان) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, so the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّ كَيْدَ الشَّيْطانِ كانَ ضَعِيفاً﴾: (كان) and its khabar; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the khabar of (إن), and (كيد) is its noun. The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾: the i'rab of (ألم) has preceded; (تر) is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the omission of the weak letter; its fāʿil (agent) is "أنت" (you). ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تر). ﴿قِيلَ لَهُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the passive verb (قيل); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كُفُّوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and likewise the two conjoined clauses ﴿وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ﴾. ﴿فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقِتالُ﴾: (كتب) is a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; (القتال) is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (لما) is adverbial, containing the sense of a condition, and the clause after it is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); or it is a particle of "existence upon existence" (ḥarf wujūd li-wujūd). ﴿إِذا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾: (إذا) is the (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya), a particle with no grammatical position; it has also been said to be an adverb. (فريق) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (منهم) is attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فريق), and the clause ﴿يَخْشَوْنَ النَّاسَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate). ﴿كَخَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (الله), the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ أَشَدَّ﴾: conjoined to the omitted (خشية); it has also been said to be conjoined to (كخشية). ﴿خَشْيَةً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَقالُوا رَبَّنا﴾: the clause is resumptive or conjoined; (ربنا) is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿لَمْ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (كتبت). ﴿كَتَبْتَ عَلَيْنَا الْقِتالَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. The clause is the object of the speech. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أَخَّرْتَنا﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿قَرِيبٍ﴾: naʿt. The clause is the object of the speech. ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive, and the nominal clause ﴿مَتاعُ الدُّنْيا قَلِيلٌ﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the object of the speech, and (الدنيا) is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِمَنِ﴾: attached to (خير), and the clause ﴿اتَّقى﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun (من). ﴿وَلا تُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا﴾: (لا) is negating, and a passive imperfect; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; (فتيلا) stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq. The clause is conjoined by the wāw before it.

daas-irab:78-78.t: ﴿أَيْنَما﴾: a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تكونوا) if it is complete (tāmma), or to its khabar (predicate) if it is defective (nāqiṣa). ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾: a complete imperfect verb, with the wāw as fāʿil (agent); or a defective imperfect, with the wāw as its noun. It is jussive (majzūm) by the omission of the nūn because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿يُدْرِكْكُمُ الْمَوْتُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with its object and its fāʿil. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with the connective fāʾ of the apodosis or with the (إذا) of surprise. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; (لو) is conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ فِي بُرُوجٍ﴾: (كان) and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar. The clause is circumstantial. ﴿مُشَيَّدَةٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ حَسَنَةٌ﴾: (إن) is a jussive conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis, with its object and its fāʿil. The clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, the apodosis, jussive; its fāʿil is the wāw. ﴿هذِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَقُولُوا هذِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿قُلْ كُلٌّ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ﴾: (كل) is a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to its omitted khabar; (الله), the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) after the verb (قل). ﴿فَمالِ هؤُلاءِ الْقَوْمِ﴾: (ما) is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾: a badal (substitute), genitive. The clause is resumptive after the fāʾ. ﴿لا يَكادُونَ﴾: a defective imperfect verb; the wāw is its noun, and (لا) is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿يَفْقَهُونَ حَدِيثاً﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (يكادون), and the clause (لا يكادون) is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:79-80.t:
﴿ما أَصابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ﴾: (ما) is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أصابك) is a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَمِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "فهي من الله" (then it is from Allah). The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما). ﴿وَما أَصابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَفْسِكَ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَأَرْسَلْناكَ لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: a ḥāl, accusative. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيداً﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; (شهيدا) is a tamyīz (specification), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined).
﴿مَنْ يُطِعِ الرَّسُولَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis, and its object; the conditional noun (من) is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَقَدْ أَطاعَ اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and a past verb and its object; (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من). ﴿وَمَنْ تَوَلَّى﴾: (من) is conditional, and a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; its fāʿil is "هو" (he), and the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَما أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), and (ما) is negating. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: attached to the ḥāl ﴿حَفِيظاً﴾. The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "ومن تولى فلا تأبهن به" (and whoever turns away, pay no heed to him); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من).

daas-irab:81-82.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ طاعَةٌ﴾: (طاعة) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "أمرنا طاعة" (our affair is obedience); the nominal clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَإِذا بَرَزُوا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); (إذا) is an adverb for future time, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَيَّتَ طائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ غَيْرَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; (غير) is its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (طائفة). The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿الَّذِي تَقُولُ﴾: the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَكْتُبُ ما يُبَيِّتُونَ﴾: (ما) is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb (يكتب); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله), and the nominal clause (والله ...) is circumstantial. (يبيتون) is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) non-jussive condition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction and (لا) is negating; the implied form is "أفلا يسمعون القرآن فيتدبرونه" (do they not then hear the Quran and reflect on it?). ﴿يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلَوْ كانَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; (لو) is a conditional particle; (كان) is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the Quran. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿غَيْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, also muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَوَجَدُوا فِيهِ اخْتِلافاً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: naʿt.

daas-irab:83-84.t:
﴿وَإِذا جاءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مِنَ الْأَمْنِ﴾: a past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (أمر). (إذا) is an adverb for future time, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَوِ الْخَوْفِ﴾: conjoined to (الأمن). ﴿أَذاعُوا بِهِ﴾: a past verb, the wāw is its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلَوْ رَدُّوهُ إِلَى الرَّسُولِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لو) is conditional; (ردوه) is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object. The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (وإذا جاءهم). ﴿وَإِلى أُولِي الْأَمْرِ﴾: conjoined to (إلى الرسول); (أولي) is genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; (الأمر) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أولي الأمر). ﴿لَعَلِمَهُ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb and its object, and the relative noun is the fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis of (لو), with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source text reads «جواب لولا محل لها», evidently for «جواب لو لا محل لها»; translated accordingly.]
﴿يَسْتَنْبِطُونَهُ مِنْهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلَوْلا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (لولا) is a non-jussive conditional particle; (فضل) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "منزل عليكم" (sent down upon you). ﴿وَرَحْمَتُهُ﴾: conjoined to (فضل). ﴿لَاتَّبَعْتُمُ الشَّيْطانَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the apodosis of (لولا), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: the excepted, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿فَقاتِلْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and the clause is the apodosis of a condition [Translator's note: the source reads «جواب شرط لها», apparently for «جواب شرط لا محل لها», "with no grammatical position"], i.e. "إذا لم يردوا الأمر إليك فقاتل" (if they do not refer the matter to you, then fight). ﴿لا تُكَلَّفُ إِلَّا نَفْسَكَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb and its object; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) and (لا) is negating. The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَحَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَكُفَّ بَأْسَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb after it is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (عسى), and (الله) is its noun. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is its ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ بَأْساً﴾: a mubtadaʾ, a khabar and a tamyīz (specification); the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَأَشَدُّ تَنْكِيلًا﴾: conjoined.

daas-irab:85-86.t: ﴿مَنْ يَشْفَعْ شَفاعَةً﴾: an imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (شفاعة) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَنَةً﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهُ نَصِيبٌ﴾: its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَمَنْ يَشْفَعْ شَفاعَةً سَيِّئَةً يَكُنْ لَهُ كِفْلٌ مِنْها﴾: like the previous verse, and it is conjoined. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقِيتاً﴾: (كان) and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar ﴿مُقِيتاً﴾. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِذا حُيِّيتُمْ بِتَحِيَّةٍ﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the tāʾ is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إذا) is an adverb attached to (حيوا). ﴿فَحَيُّوا بِأَحْسَنَ مِنْها﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بأحسن): a noun genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is an adjective on the pattern afʿal; the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْها﴾: attached to (أحسن). ﴿أَوْ رُدُّوها﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَسِيباً﴾: (إن), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (كان) and its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; its noun is omitted. The clause is the khabar of (إن).

daas-irab:87-88.t: ﴿اللَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (لا) is the lā of generic negation, and its noun is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "موجود" (existent); the clause is the khabar. (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (هو) is a badal (substitute) for the noun of (لا) in respect of its position, or a badal for the position of (لا) and its noun. ﴿لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb indeclinable on fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis; the clause occurs as the response to an implied (muqaddar) oath. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ﴾: (لا) is the lā of generic negation, and its noun is indeclinable on fatḥa; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar. The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثاً﴾: a mubtadaʾ and khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; (حديثا) is a tamyīz (specification). ﴿فَما لَكُمْ﴾: (ما) is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿فِي الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾: attached to (فئتين); some parsed it as the khabar of an omitted (كان), the implied form being: "فما لكم في المنافقين كنتم فئتين" (what is the matter with you that, regarding the hypocrites, you became two parties?). ﴿فِئَتَيْنِ﴾: a ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَرْكَسَهُمْ﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause (أركسهم) is the khabar. ﴿بِما كَسَبُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (أركسهم); or (ما) is a relative noun. ﴿أَتُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَهْدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the interpreted maṣdar is its object, i.e. "هداية" (guiding). ﴿مَنْ أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause after it is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ﴾: (من) is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ, and the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. The clause (ومن ...) is resumptive. ﴿فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُ سَبِيلًا﴾: an imperfect, accusative (manṣūb), and its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a ḥāl of (سبيلا). The clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:89-89.t: ﴿وَدُّوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ﴾: (لو) is maṣdar-forming; together with the verb after it, it is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "ودوا كفركم" (they wished for your disbelief). ﴿كَما كَفَرُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from (ما) and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by the kāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: "ودوا لو تكفرون كفرا مثل كفرهم" (they wished you would disbelieve with a disbelief like theirs). ﴿فَتَكُونُونَ سَواءً﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the wāw is its noun and (سواء) its khabar (predicate). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (تكفرون). ﴿فَلا تَتَّخِذُوا مِنْهُمْ أَوْلِياءَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (lā al-nāhiya); the wāw is its fāʿil and (أولياء) its second object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and they are the first object of (تتخذوا). ﴿حَتَّى يُهاجِرُوا﴾: an imperfect, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muḍmara) (أن) after (حتى); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by (حتى), and the two are attached to (تتخذوا). The clause (تتخذوا) is the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition after the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: attached to (يهاجروا). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَخُذُوهُمْ﴾: (إن) is conditional; (تولوا) is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. (خذوهم) is an imperative verb indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object. The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause ﴿فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾ is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَاقْتُلُوهُمْ﴾: like (خذوهم), and it is conjoined to it. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: an adverb of place indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, attached to (اقتلوهم). ﴿وَجَدْتُمُوهُمْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the wāw is the wāw of lengthening (ishbāʿ), since the mīm was given a ḍamma. The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَلا تَتَّخِذُوا مِنْهُمْ وَلِيًّا وَلا نَصِيراً﴾: like ﴿فَلا تَتَّخِذُوا﴾ before it; the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:90-90.t: ﴿إِلَّا الَّذِينَ﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as excepted from (خذوهم), and the clause ﴿يَصِلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِلى قَوْمٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَبَيْنَهُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِيثاقٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of a naʿt (adjective) of (قوم). ﴿أَوْ جاؤُكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause (يصلون). ﴿حَصِرَتْ صُدُورُهُمْ أَنْ يُقاتِلُوكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, i.e. "عن قتالكم" (from fighting you), and the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَوْ يُقاتِلُوا قَوْمَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect, accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil and its object; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined, i.e. "عن قتالكم وقتال قومهم" (from fighting you and fighting their people). The clause ﴿حَصِرَتْ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), on the assumption of (قد) before it. ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; (لو) is a conditional particle. The clause is resumptive. ﴿لَسَلَّطَهُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of (لو), and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the hāʾ is its object. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَلَقاتَلُوكُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to (لسلطهم). ﴿فَإِنِ اعْتَزَلُوكُمْ﴾: (إن) is conditional, and a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فَلَمْ يُقاتِلُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect, jussive by the omission of the nūn, with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَأَلْقَوْا﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَيْكُمُ﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿السَّلَمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَما جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ سَبِيلًا﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent [Translator's note: so in the source, although the Name of Majesty is overt here], to which the preposition and its genitive noun (لكم) are attached, and they are the first object; (سبيلا) is the second object; (عليهم) is attached to an omitted ḥāl of (سبيلا). (ما) is negating, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

daas-irab:91-91.t: ﴿سَتَجِدُونَ آخَرِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the sīn is for futurity. ﴿يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَأْمَنُوكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the interpreted maṣdar is its object. The clause ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of (آخرين). ﴿وَيَأْمَنُوا قَوْمَهُمْ﴾: like the preceding one; a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; (يأمنوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يأمنوكم)], its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿كُلَّما رُدُّوا إِلَى الْفِتْنَةِ﴾: (ردوا) is a passive past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), because it is preceded by the adverb of time (كلما). ﴿أُرْكِسُوا فِيها﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because (كلما) carries the sense of a condition. ﴿فَإِنْ لَمْ يَعْتَزِلُوكُمْ﴾: (إن) is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم), in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil and its object. The clause is resumptive after the fāʾ. ﴿وَيُلْقُوا إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَمَ﴾: the verbal clause with its fāʿil and its object is conjoined to what precedes it, and likewise ﴿وَيَكُفُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾. ﴿فَخُذُوهُمْ﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, after the connective (rābiṭa) fāʾ. ﴿وَاقْتُلُوهُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾: an adverb of place indeclinable on ḍamma, attached to (اقتلوهم). ﴿ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the ḍamma of the mīm was lengthened into a wāw. The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَأُولئِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جَعَلْنا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطاناً مُبِيناً﴾: its i'rab is like (فما جعل الله) in the previous verse; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أولئكم), and the clause (أولئكم) is resumptive.

daas-irab:92-92.t: ﴿وَما كانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ﴾: (كان), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); (ما) is negating. The clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ يَقْتُلَ مُؤْمِناً﴾: (أن) is subjunctive-governing, and an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as the noun of (كان). ﴿إِلَّا خَطَأً﴾: (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (خطأ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, i.e. "مخطئا" (erring); or it stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "قتلا خطأ" (a killing by mistake); or it is by omission of the preposition, i.e. "بخطأ" (by mistake). ﴿وَمَنْ قَتَلَ مُؤْمِناً خَطَأً﴾: (من) is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (قتل) is a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is latent, (مؤمنا) is its object and (خطأ) a ḥāl. ﴿فَتَحْرِيرُ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "فكفارته تحرير" (then his expiation is the freeing) or "هي تحرير" (it is the freeing). ﴿رَقَبَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُؤْمِنَةٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَدِيَةٌ﴾: conjoined to (تحرير). ﴿مُسَلَّمَةٌ﴾: naʿt. ﴿إِلى أَهْلِهِ﴾: attached to (مسلمة). The nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِلَّا أَنْ يَصَّدَّقُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl: "إلا متصدقين" (unless giving it in charity); or in the position of the genitive by annexation: "إلا حين تصدقهم" (except at the time of their giving it in charity). ﴿فَإِنْ كانَ مِنْ قَوْمٍ عَدُوٍّ لَكُمْ﴾: (إن) is conditional; (من قوم): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of (كان), whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: "هو"; (عدو) [Translator's note: (لكم) is evidently meant here] is attached to an omitted naʿt of (عدو). The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُؤْمِنَةٍ﴾: like the preceding one. ﴿وَإِنْ كانَ مِنْ قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ مِيثاقٌ﴾: something similar has preceded. ﴿فَدِيَةٌ مُسَلَّمَةٌ إِلى أَهْلِهِ﴾: like ﴿وَدِيَةٌ مُسَلَّمَةٌ﴾. ﴿وَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُؤْمِنَةٍ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيامُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by (لم), in the position of the jussive as the protasis; its fāʿil is latent, and the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ. The fāʾ is resumptive [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere this fāʾ is called connective (rābiṭa)], and (صيام) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of (من), and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من). ﴿شَهْرَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿مُتَتابِعَيْنِ﴾: naʿt. ﴿تَوْبَةً مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq: "فليتب توبة" (let him repent with a repentance), or a ḥāl; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of (توبة). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded.

daas-irab:93-94.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِناً مُتَعَمِّداً﴾: (من) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and a jussive imperfect, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (متعمدا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿فَجَزاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and a mubtadaʾ and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿خالِداً فِيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ḥāl before them. ﴿وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿وَلَعَنَهُ﴾: a past verb and its object; the fāʿil is "هو" (He). ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُ عَذاباً﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: naʿt (adjective) of the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (عذابا). All the clauses are maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِذا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it. The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), because it follows the adverb (إذا). ﴿فَتَبَيَّنُوا﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect, jussive by the prohibitive (lā al-nāhiya); the wāw is its fāʿil. The clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿لِمَنْ أَلْقى إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلامَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is "هو" (he), to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; (السلام) is its object. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of (من), and (لمن) is attached to (تقولوا). ﴿لَسْتَ مُؤْمِناً﴾: (ليس), its noun and its khabar; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿تَبْتَغُونَ عَرَضَ الْحَياةِ الدُّنْيا﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; (الدنيا) is a naʿt of (الحياة). The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَغانِمُ﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ (مغانم); the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كَثِيرَةٌ﴾: naʿt. ﴿كَذلِكَ كُنْتُمْ﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (كنتم), and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by annexation; or (كذلك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of (كنتم); the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: an adverb of time indeclinable on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of the genitive by (من); the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause is resumptive. ﴿فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَتَبَيَّنُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition: "إذا أدركتم ذلك فتبينوا" (if you have grasped that, then verify). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيراً﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded.

daas-irab:95-96.t: ﴿لا يَسْتَوِي الْقاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: (لا) is negating, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (القاعدون). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of (القاعدون). It has been read in the genitive, as a naʿt of (المؤمنين), and in the accusative, as an exception. ﴿أُولِي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, and ﴿الضَّرَرِ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْمُجاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: conjoined to (القاعدون); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿الْمُجاهِدُونَ﴾. ﴿بِأَمْوالِهِمْ﴾: likewise attached to (المجاهدون). ﴿وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ الْمُجاهِدِينَ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; (المجاهدين) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿بِأَمْوالِهِمْ﴾: attached to ﴿الْمُجاهِدِينَ﴾. ﴿وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿عَلَى الْقاعِدِينَ﴾: attached to (فضل). ﴿دَرَجَةً﴾: a tamyīz (specification) or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); some said it is an adverb. ﴿وَكُلًّا﴾: a fronted first object of the verb (وعد). ﴿وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْحُسْنى﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; (الحسنى) is the second object. The clause is parenthetical. ﴿وَفَضَّلَ اللَّهُ الْمُجاهِدِينَ عَلَى الْقاعِدِينَ أَجْراً﴾: (أجرا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq, or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "بأجر" (with a reward). ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: naʿt. ﴿دَرَجاتٍ مِنْهُ﴾: a badal (substitute) of ﴿أَجْراً﴾, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted naʿt. ﴿وَمَغْفِرَةً وَرَحْمَةً﴾: conjoined. The clause ﴿فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ﴾ before it. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾: the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:97-99.t:
﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾: (إن), and the relative noun is its noun; (تتوفاهم) is an imperfect verb [Translator's note: the source parses the verse's (توفاهم) as the imperfect (تتوفاهم), i.e. with one tāʾ elided], the hāʾ is its object and (الملائكة) its fāʿil (agent). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿ظالِمِي﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ; the nūn was dropped for the annexation. ﴿أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of (إنّ). ﴿فِيمَ كُنْتُمْ﴾: (ما) is an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of (كنتم). Its alif was dropped because the preposition entered upon it. The clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا كُنَّا مُسْتَضْعَفِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: (كان), its noun and its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the clause is the object of the speech, and the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَرْضُ اللَّهِ واسِعَةً﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم), with its noun and its khabar; (الله), the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi, and the hamza is for interrogation. The clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) after (قالوا). ﴿فَتُهاجِرُوا فِيها﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the fāʾ of causation (sababiyya); the wāw is the fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to an implied maṣdar taken from the preceding verb. The preposition and its genitive noun (فيها) are attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ مَأْواهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (مأواهم) is a second mubtadaʾ, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, whose khabar is (جهنم); the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك). ﴿وَساءَتْ مَصِيراً﴾: a past verb of blame; (مصيرا) is a tamyīz (specification); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun explained by this tamyīz, and the one specifically blamed is omitted, i.e. (جهنم). The clause is resumptive.
﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ﴾: the excepted, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِنَ الرِّجالِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَالنِّساءِ وَالْوِلْدانِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective). [Translator's note: (الذين) does not occur in the verse; the source has it here.] ﴿لا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ حِيلَةً﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of (المستضعفين). ﴿وَلا يَهْتَدُونَ سَبِيلًا﴾: the clause is like the preceding one and is conjoined to it. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَسَى اللَّهُ﴾: a rigid (jāmid), defective past verb, and (الله), the Name of Majesty, is its noun; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أَنْ يَعْفُوَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ are attached to (يعفو). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَفُوًّا غَفُوراً﴾: (كان), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (عفوا) and (غفورا) are its two khabars. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:100-100.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يُهاجِرْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾: (من) is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) is jussive (majzūm), and the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿يَجِدْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُراغَماً﴾: (يجد) is an imperfect, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; its fāʿil is latent, and (مراغما) is its object. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَسَعَةً﴾: conjoined. The protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of (من). ﴿وَمَنْ يَخْرُجْ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ مُهاجِراً إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ﴾: (مهاجرا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; (رسوله) is conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ يُدْرِكْهُ الْمَوْتُ﴾: conjoined to (ومن يهاجر). [Translator's note: so in the source; (يدركه) is conjoined to the protasis (يخرج).] ﴿فَقَدْ وَقَعَ أَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, because it is joined with the connective (rābiṭa) fāʾ; (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾: its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:101-101.t: ﴿وَإِذا ضَرَبْتُمْ﴾: (إذا) is an adverb for future time, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ضربتم). ﴿فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُناحٌ﴾: (ليس) and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ تَقْصُرُوا مِنَ الصَّلاةِ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb is in the position of the genitive by a preposition: "في قصر الصلاة" (in shortening the prayer); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (جناح), and (من الصلاة) is attached to the verb before them, (تقصروا). The clause (فليس) has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنْ خِفْتُمْ﴾: (إن) is conditional, and a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is attached to the tāʾ of the agent; the tāʾ is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿أَنْ يَفْتِنَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "فتنة" (tempting); the relative noun is the fāʿil, and the clause (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The apodosis of (إن) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ الْكافِرِينَ﴾: (إن) and its noun, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿كانُوا لَكُمْ عَدُوًّا﴾: (كان), its noun and its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عدوا). ﴿مُبِيناً﴾: naʿt. The clause (كانوا) is the khabar of (إن).

daas-irab:102-102.t: ﴿وَإِذا كُنْتَ فِيهِمْ﴾: (كان) and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to the adverb (إذا). ﴿فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ الصَّلاةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَلْتَقُمْ طائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾: (منهم) is attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (طائفة). ﴿مَعَكَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb (تقم), which is jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَلْيَأْخُذُوا أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect, jussive by the omission of the nūn, with its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَإِذا سَجَدُوا﴾: the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَلْيَكُونُوا مِنْ وَرائِكُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the wāw is its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar. The clause is the apodosis of (إذا). ﴿وَلْتَأْتِ طائِفَةٌ﴾: an imperfect, jussive by the omission of the weak letter, and its fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿أُخْرى﴾: naʿt. ﴿لَمْ يُصَلُّوا﴾: the clause is a second naʿt. ﴿فَلْيُصَلُّوا مَعَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, a fāʿil and an adverb. ﴿وَلْيَأْخُذُوا حِذْرَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi. The two clauses are maʿṭūf. ﴿وَدَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ تَغْفُلُونَ عَنْ أَسْلِحَتِكُمْ﴾: a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdar-forming (لو) and the verb after it is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "ودوا غفلتكم" (they wished for your neglect). ﴿فَيَمِيلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَيْلَةً واحِدَةً﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; (ميلة) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and (واحدة) a naʿt. The clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: (لا) is the lā of generic negation, and its noun is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar. The clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ كانَ بِكُمْ أَذىً مِنْ مَطَرٍ﴾: (كان) and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun (بكم) are attached to its omitted khabar; (من مطر) is attached to an omitted naʿt of (أذى). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; (كان) is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause (إن كان) is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضى﴾: (كان), its noun and its khabar; the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿أَنْ تَضَعُوا أَسْلِحَتَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb is in the position of the genitive by a preposition: "من وضع أسلحتكم" (in laying down your weapons), and the two are attached to (جناح). ﴿وَخُذُوا حِذْرَكُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْكافِرِينَ عَذاباً مُهِيناً﴾: the clause ﴿أَعَدَّ﴾ is the khabar of (إن), and the clause ﴿إِنْ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ﴾: «يا» is the vocative particle; «أي» is a munādā (one addressed), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; the hāʾ is for drawing attention; «الناس» is a badal (substitute); the clause «اتقوا ربكم» is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, adjective (ṣifa) of «ربكم», and the clause ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ نَفْسٍ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلقكم». ﴿واحِدَةٍ﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَخَلَقَ مِنْها﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿زَوْجَها﴾: its object. ﴿وَبَثَّ مِنْهُما رِجالًا كَثِيراً وَنِساءً﴾: a past verb and its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; «كثيرا» is an adjective and «نساء» is conjoined. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to the first «اتقوا». ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, adjective of «الله». ﴿تَسائَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its agent. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَالْأَرْحامَ﴾: conjoined to «الله».
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun (ism). ﴿كانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيباً﴾: kāna, and «رقيبا» is its khabar (predicate), to which the preposition and genitive noun before it are attached; the noun of kāna is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to Allah; the clause ﴿كانَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar [of inna], and the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿وَآتُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive or resumptive; «آتوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْيَتامى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: second direct object; the clause is conjoined or resumptive. ﴿وَلا تَتَبَدَّلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. ﴿الْخَبِيثَ﴾: direct object. ﴿بِالطَّيِّبِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تتبدلوا». ﴿وَلا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it and is parsed like it. ﴿إِلى أَمْوالِكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّهُ كانَ حُوباً كَبِيراً﴾: like ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيباً﴾.

daas-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «إن» is a jussive conditional. ﴿خِفْتُمْ﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أن﴾: a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتامى﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is its agent; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَانْكِحُوا ما طابَ لَكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, the wāw being its agent and the relative noun its object; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «لكم» is attached to «طاب», and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ النِّساءِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) agent.
﴿مَثْنى﴾: a ḥāl, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because [its appearance] is impossible. ﴿وَثُلاثَ وَرُباعَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا﴾: like ﴿وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوا﴾, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿فَواحِدَةً﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; «واحدة» is the direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "then marry one"; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَوْ ما مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾: «أو» is conjunctive, and [then] a past verb and its agent; «ما» is conjoined to «واحدة», and the clause ﴿مَلَكَتْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun before it. ﴿ذلِكَ أَدْنى﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَلَّا تَعُولُوا﴾: like ﴿أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوا﴾; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by a preposition, its implied form being "nearer to not inclining (أدنى من عدم العول)"; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:4-5.t: ﴿وَآتُوا النِّساءَ صَدُقاتِهِنَّ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects. ﴿نِحْلَةً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "give a free gift"; or ḥāl (circumstantial) meaning "giving freely"; or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) meaning "as a religious duty". ﴿فَإِنْ طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: «إن» is conditional; «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «طبن»; «طبن» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn of the feminine plural is its agent, and «عن شيء» is attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «شيء». ﴿نَفْساً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿فَكُلُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is connective, and [then] an imperative verb, its agent and its object. ﴿هَنِيئاً مَرِيئاً﴾: two ḥāls; it is also said [they are] two adjectives of an omitted absolute object. The clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَلا تُؤْتُوا السُّفَهاءَ أَمْوالَكُمُ﴾: «لا» is prohibitive, and [then] a jussive imperfect verb, its agent and its two objects; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun, adjective of «أموالكم». ﴿جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِياماً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the Divine Name is its agent, and «قياما» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «جعل», the first object being omitted, the implied form being "He made it a support for you"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَارْزُقُوهُمْ فِيها﴾: an imperative verb, its agent and a direct object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined, and likewise ﴿وَاكْسُوهُمْ، وَقُولُوا لَهُمْ﴾. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾: absolute object. ﴿مَعْرُوفاً﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتامى﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا بَلَغُوا النِّكاحَ﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object; «إذا» is an adverb of future time, and the clause after it is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ آنَسْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ رُشْداً﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the response to «إذا», and the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: the clause is like the preceding one; the imperative verb has the preposition and genitive noun attached (mutaʿalliq) to it, the wāw is its agent and «أموالهم» its object; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَلا تَأْكُلُوها إِسْرافاً وَبِداراً﴾: the prohibitive «لا», [then] an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, its agent and its object; «إسرافا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and «بدارا» is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ يَكْبَرُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as a direct object, i.e. "hastening", or as an object of purpose, i.e. "for fear that they grow up". ﴿وَمَنْ كانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ﴾: «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); [then] kāna and its khabar (predicate), its noun (ism) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause «فليستعفف» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the imperfect verb «فليستعفف» is jussive by the lām of command that precedes it; the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis are the khabar of «من». ﴿وَمَنْ كانَ فَقِيراً فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِذا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and [then] a past verb, its agent and a direct object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيباً﴾: «بالله»: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and «الله», the Divine Name, is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the agent of «كفى»; «حسيبا» is a tamyīz (specification); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿لِلرِّجالِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿نَصِيبٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «نصيب». ﴿تَرَكَ الْوالِدانِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative with alif because it is a dual. ﴿وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ﴾: conjoined to «الوالدان»; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلِلنِّساءِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوالِدانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding. ﴿مِمَّا قَلَّ مِنْهُ﴾: «مما» is a badal (substitute) of the first «مما». ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: attached to «قل»; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿أَوْ كَثُرَ﴾: conjoined to «قل». ﴿نَصِيباً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it means "a giving"; it is also said to be a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَفْرُوضاً﴾: an accusative adjective.

daas-irab:8-9.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «إذا» is an adverb of future time. ﴿حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُوا﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the fāʿil (agent), nominative with wāw because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿الْقُرْبى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينُ﴾: conjoined to «أولو». ﴿فَارْزُقُوهُمْ مِنْهُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, to which the preposition and genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its agent and the hāʾ its object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَقُولُوا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَعْرُوفاً﴾: an imperative verb, its agent, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and its adjective (ṣifa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a verb of command, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the relative noun is the agent. ﴿لَوْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً﴾: a past verb, its agent and a direct object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿ضِعافاً﴾: an adjective. ﴿خافُوا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلْيَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command; the wāw is the agent and «الله», the Divine Name, is a direct object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلْيَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيداً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, its agent, an absolute object and its adjective; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوالَ الْيَتامى﴾: inna, and the relative noun is in the position of accusative as its noun (ism); the verbal clause, made of the verb, the fāʿil (agent) and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «اليتامى» is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ظُلْماً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "wrongfully", or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿إِنَّما يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ ناراً﴾: an imperfect verb, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, [then] its agent and its object; «إنما» is [inna with] the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَسَيَصْلَوْنَ سَعِيراً﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its agent; «سعيرا» is its object; the sīn is for the future; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:11-11.t:
﴿يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلادِكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; «مثل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; «حظ» is muḍāf ilayhi, and «الأنثيين» is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with yāʾ because it is a dual [Translator's note: the source prints «بالباء», evidently for «بالياء»]; the clause is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl), because «يوصيكم» has the meaning of saying; it is also said [to be] explicative. ﴿فَإِنْ كُنَّ نِساءً﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إن» is conditional; «كن» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the nūn of the feminine plural being its noun (ism), and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «نساء» is its khabar. ﴿فَوْقَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «نساء», or a second khabar of «كن». ﴿اثْنَتَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلَهُنَّ ثُلُثا ما تَرَكَ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «لهن» is attached to an omitted khabar; «ثلثا» is a mubtadaʾ, nominative with alif because it is a dual; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause «ترك» is its ṣila (relative clause); the clause ﴿فَلَهُنَّ ... ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَإِنْ كانَتْ واحِدَةً﴾: conjoined to ﴿فَإِنْ كُنَّ ... ﴾; the noun of kāna is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form «هي» [she]; ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ is its khabar. ﴿فَلَهَا النِّصْفُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَلِأَبَوَيْهِ لِكُلِّ واحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «لأبويه» is attached to an omitted khabar placed first; «لكل» is a badal (substitute) of «أبويه»; «منهما» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «السدس». And the clause «ترك» is a ṣila. ﴿إِنْ كانَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ﴾: kāna and its noun, and a preposition and genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلَدٌ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of «يكن», and «ولد» is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَوَرِثَهُ أَبَواهُ﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the agent, nominative with alif because it is a dual. ﴿فَلِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَإِنْ كانَ لَهُ إِخْوَةٌ فَلِأُمِّهِ السُّدُسُ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ﴾: some attached the preposition and its genitive noun to «يوصيكم», or to an omitted ḥāl from «السدس», or to an omitted verb, its implied form being "it is settled (يستقر)"; others attached it to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "this division is [established]"; «وصية» is muḍāf ilayhi. And the clause ﴿يُوصِي بِها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the imperfect verb, and the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective. ﴿أَوْ دَيْنٍ﴾: conjoined to «وصية».
﴿آباؤُكُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَبْناؤُكُمْ﴾: conjoined, and the clause ﴿لا تَدْرُونَ﴾ is its khabar. ﴿أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ لَكُمْ نَفْعاً﴾: «أي» is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar «أقرب»; «نفعا» is a tamyīz (specification); the clause stands in place of the two objects of «تدرون», which is suspended [from governing] by the interrogative; it is also permissible to parse «أيهم» as a relative noun, the first direct object, the second object being omitted, and «أقرب» as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَرِيضَةً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective of «فريضة». ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كانَ عَلِيماً﴾: kāna and its khabar, its noun being a latent pronoun. ﴿حَكِيماً﴾: a second khabar; the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:103-104.t: ﴿فَإِذا قَضَيْتُمُ الصَّلاةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of (إذا), with no grammatical position. ﴿قِياماً وَقُعُوداً﴾: two ḥāls (circumstantials). ﴿وَعَلى جُنُوبِكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl as well. ﴿فَإِذَا اطْمَأْنَنْتُمْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾: the clause is the apodosis of (إذا), and the clause ﴿إذا﴾ is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ كانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتاباً﴾: (كان) and its khabar (predicate); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿مَوْقُوتاً﴾: a naʿt (adjective), to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached. The clause ﴿كانَتْ﴾ is the khabar of (إن), and the clause ﴿إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿وَلا تَهِنُوا فِي ابْتِغاءِ﴾: an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the omission of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ تَكُونُوا تَأْلَمُونَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is its noun and the clause (تألمون) its khabar. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ يَأْلَمُونَ﴾: (إن) and its noun, and the clause (تألمون) [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse here has (يألمون)] is its khabar; the clause ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿كَما تَأْلَمُونَ﴾: its i'rab resembles that in verse 89. ﴿وَتَرْجُونَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ما لا يَرْجُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the relative noun (ما) is its object; the clause ﴿يَرْجُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of this relative noun. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded.

daas-irab:105-106.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتابَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; (إليك) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الكتاب). The clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن), and (نا) is its noun. ﴿لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ﴾: an imperfect, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن) — its fāʿil is latent (mustatir) — implied (muḍmara) after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); its fāʿil is latent. [Translator's note: the source mentions the latent fāʿil twice, as rendered.] The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (أنزلنا); the adverb of place (بين) is attached to the verb before it. ﴿بِما أَراكَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) before it, and the preposition and its genitive noun (بما) are attached to the verb before them, ﴿تحكم﴾. ﴿وَلا تَكُنْ لِلْخائِنِينَ خَصِيماً﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (خصيما) after them. The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb, and the Name of Majesty is its object; the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾: its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:107-108.t: ﴿وَلا تُجادِلْ﴾: an imperfect, jussive (majzūm), and its fāʿil (agent) is "أنت" (you); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿عَنِ الَّذِينَ يَخْتانُونَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تجادل). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُحِبُّ مَنْ﴾: (إن) and its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يُحِبُّ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ is mafʿūl bihi. The clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كانَ خَوَّاناً أَثِيماً﴾: (كان) and its khabar, and (أثيما) is its naʿt (adjective); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَهُوَ مَعَهُمْ﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the adverb is attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), after the wāw of the ḥāl. ﴿إِذْ يُبَيِّتُونَ﴾: (إذ) is an adverb for past time, and the verbal clause after it is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ما لا يَرْضى مِنَ الْقَوْلِ﴾: (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (لا) is negating, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ بِما يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطاً﴾: (كان), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (بما) is attached to the khabar (محيطا), and the clause (يعملون) is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:109-110.t: ﴿ها أَنْتُمْ هؤُلاءِ جادَلْتُمْ﴾: (أنتم) is a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is (هؤلاء), and the clause ﴿جادَلْتُمْ﴾ is a second khabar. ﴿عَنْهُمْ فِي الْحَياةِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: naʿt (adjective) of (الحياة). ﴿فَمَنْ يُجادِلُ اللَّهَ عَنْهُمْ﴾: (من) is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يُجادِلُ اللَّهَ﴾ is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun (عنهم) are attached to the verb before them. ﴿يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ﴾: an adverb of time, also attached to the verb. The clause ﴿فَمَنْ يُجادِلُ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَمْ مَنْ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: "هو"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (وكيلا). The clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من), and the clause ﴿أَمْ مَنْ﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءاً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent and (سوءا) is its object; the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُ﴾: conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ﴾: also conjoined; the verb was given a kasra to avoid the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿يَجِدِ اللَّهَ غَفُوراً﴾: an imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and its two objects; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿رَحِيماً﴾: naʿt. The protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).

daas-irab:111-112.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يَكْسِبْ إِثْماً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and (إنما) [Translator's note: so in the source, evidently a misprint for (إثما)] is its object; the conditional noun (من) is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَإِنَّما يَكْسِبُهُ عَلى نَفْسِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil is latent. The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾: (كان), and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ يَكْسِبْ خَطِيئَةً أَوْ إِثْماً﴾: like the preceding one. ﴿ثُمَّ يَرْمِ بِهِ﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to (يكسب), jussive by the omission of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿بَرِيئاً﴾: its object. ﴿فَقَدِ احْتَمَلَ بُهْتاناً﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of (من). ﴿وَإِثْماً مُبِيناً﴾: conjoined to (بهتانا); (مبينا) is a naʿt (adjective).

daas-irab:113-113.t: ﴿وَلَوْلا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ﴾: (لولا) is a non-jussive conditional particle; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the mubtadaʾ (subject) (فضل), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿لَهَمَّتْ طائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (طائفة). The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿أَنْ يُضِلُّوكَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, the implied form being: "لهمت بإضلالك" (would have resolved upon misleading you). ﴿وَما يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) and (ما) is negating. The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما يَضُرُّونَكَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). (من شيء): (من) is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شيء) is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: "شيئا من الضرر" (any harm). ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتابَ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; (الكتاب) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. The clause is likewise maʿṭūf. ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَعَلَّمَكَ ما﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and the relative noun (ما) after it is a second mafʿūl bihi; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). The clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿لَمْ تَكُنْ تَعْلَمُ﴾: (تكن) is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: "أنت" (you), and the clause ﴿تَعْلَمُ﴾ is its khabar. The clause (لم تكن) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَكانَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ عَظِيماً﴾: (كان), its noun and its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (عظيما).

daas-irab:114-114.t:
﴿لا خَيْرَ فِي كَثِيرٍ﴾: (لا) is the lā of generic negation, and its noun is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ نَجْواهُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (كثير). ﴿إِلَّا مَنْ أَمَرَ﴾: (إلا) is a particle of exception; (من) is a relative noun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the genitive as a badal (substitute) of (نجوى), on the assumption of a muḍāf, i.e. "إلا نجوى من أمر" (except the private talk of one who enjoins). ﴿أَمَرَ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).
﴿بِصَدَقَةٍ﴾: attached to (أمر). ﴿أَوْ مَعْرُوفٍ﴾: conjoined. ﴿أَوْ إِصْلاحٍ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ﴾: (بين) is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) (إصلاح); (الناس) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذلِكَ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); the demonstrative is its object, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ابْتِغاءَ﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مَرْضاتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. The clause (ومن يفعل) is resumptive. ﴿فَسَوْفَ نُؤْتِيهِ أَجْراً عَظِيماً﴾: an imperfect verb and its two objects; its fāʿil is latent; (عظيما) is a naʿt; (سوف) is a particle of futurity. The protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من), and the clause ﴿فَسَوْفَ نُؤْتِيهِ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
