daas-irab:115-116.t: ﴿وَمَنْ يُشاقِقِ الرَّسُولَ﴾: (من) is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يشاقق) is an imperfect, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and (الرسول) is its object; the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يشاقق). ﴿ما تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْهُدى﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; (الهدى) is its fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar formed from (ما) and the verb is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَيَتَّبِعْ﴾: conjoined to (يشاقق). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَبِيلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿نُوَلِّهِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the omission of the weak letter; its fāʿil is "نحن" (We), and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿ما تَوَلَّى﴾: (ما) is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as second object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَنُصْلِهِ جَهَنَّمَ﴾: conjoined to ﴿نُوَلِّهِ ما﴾ and like it. The clause ﴿نُوَلِّهِ﴾ is the apodosis of (من), with no grammatical position, not being linked with the fāʾ or (إذا). ﴿وَساءَتْ مَصِيراً﴾: a rigid (jāmid) past verb expressing blame; (مصيرا) is a tamyīz (specification). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: (إن), and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لا يَغْفِرُ أَنْ يُشْرَكَ﴾: (يغفر) is an imperfect verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is its object. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the passive verb (يشرك). The clause ﴿لا يَغْفِرُ ... ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن). ﴿وَيَغْفِرُ ما دُونَ ذلِكَ﴾: (ما) is the relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the adverb (دون) is attached to the omitted ṣila of (ما); (ذلك) is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: attached to (يغفر) before it, and the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَمَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ﴾: the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ; the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and the two are attached to the protasis. The clause ﴿فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلالًا بَعِيداً﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). See verse 48.

daas-irab:117-118.t: ﴿إِنْ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِلَّا إِناثاً﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and (إناثا) its object; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and (إن) is negating in the sense of (ما), with no governing effect. ﴿وَإِنْ يَدْعُونَ إِلَّا شَيْطاناً مَرِيداً﴾: like the clause before it; (مريدا) is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿وَقالَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَأَتَّخِذَنَّ مِنْ عِبادِكَ نَصِيباً﴾: an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; its fāʿil is "أنا" (I), and (نصيبا) is its object. ﴿مَفْرُوضاً﴾: naʿt. The clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the omitted oath clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:119-120.t:
﴿وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمْ﴾ (and ولأمنيهم and ولآمرنهم): like (لأتخذن); the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the three clauses are maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ﴾: its original form is ﴿فليبتكونن﴾; an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the omitted wāw is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). [Translator's note: so in the source; the lām here is usually parsed as the lām of the oath's response, with the verb nominative and the nūn of the indicative dropped before the nūn of emphasis.]
﴿آذانَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأَنْعامِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَلَآمُرَنَّهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and it is like (ولأضلنهم). ﴿فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ﴾: its original form is (يغيرونن), like (ليبتكونن); the clause is also maʿṭūf. ﴿وَمَنْ يَتَّخِذِ الشَّيْطانَ وَلِيًّا﴾: (من) is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the jussive protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its two objects; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). The clause ﴿وَمَنْ..﴾ is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (وليا). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقَدْ خَسِرَ خُسْراناً مُبِيناً﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يَعِدُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object; the second is omitted, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he); and likewise ﴿وَيُمَنِّيهِمْ﴾, the clause being maʿṭūf. ﴿وَما يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its object and its fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿إِلَّا غُرُوراً﴾: (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (غرورا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and some made it a mafʿūl bihi of (يمنيهم).

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَلَكُمْ نِصْفُ ما تَرَكَ أَزْواجُكُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «نصف»; the relative noun «ما» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause after it, «ترك أزواجكم», is its ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the conditional «إن» is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿فَإِنْ كانَ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ﴾: parsed like «إن كان له ولد» in the previous verse. ﴿فَلَكُمُ الرُّبُعُ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الربع»; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِمَّا تَرَكْنَ﴾: like the saying of Allah the Exalted ﴿مِمَّا تَرَكَ﴾ in the previous verse, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصِينَ بِها أَوْ دَيْنٍ﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿وَلَهُنَّ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْتُمْ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكُمْ وَلَدٌ﴾ up to His saying ﴿تُوصُونَ بِها أَوْ دَيْنٍ﴾: its i'rab is like ﴿وَلَكُمْ نِصْفُ ما تَرَكَ﴾ ... ﴿أَوْ دَيْنٍ﴾. ﴿وَإِنْ كانَ رَجُلٌ يُورَثُ كَلالَةً﴾: «إن» is conditional; [then] kāna and its noun (ism), and the clause «يورث» is its khabar; «كلالة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); it is also permissible to parse kāna as complete (tāmma), the clause being an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿أَوِ امْرَأَةٌ﴾: conjoined to «رجل». ﴿وَلَهُ أَخٌ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar, and «أخ» is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْ أُخْتٌ﴾: conjoined to «أخ»; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿فَلِكُلِّ واحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسُ﴾: «لكل» is attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ «السدس»; «منهما» is attached to an omitted adjective of «واحد»; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَإِنْ كانُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذلِكَ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أكثر»; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَهُمْ شُرَكاءُ فِي الثُّلُثِ﴾: the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «شركاء». ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ وَصِيَّةٍ يُوصى بِها أَوْ دَيْنٍ﴾: its i'rab has preceded; «يوصى» is a passive imperfect verb. ﴿غَيْرَ مُضَارٍّ﴾: «غير» is a ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «يوصى»; «مضار» is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَصِيَّةً مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of «وصية». ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ and its two predicates; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:13-14.t: ﴿تِلْكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حُدُودُ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «يطع» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the conditional noun «من» is a mubtadaʾ; «الله», the Divine Name, is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «رسوله» is conjoined. ﴿يُدْخِلْهُ﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive; its agent is latent and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾: its second object. ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾: the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), to which the preposition and genitive noun «فيها» are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿وَذلِكَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْفَوْزُ﴾: its khabar. ﴿الْعَظِيمُ﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ... ﴾: its i'rab is like the previous verse; ﴿يَعْصِ﴾ is jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, and likewise «يتعد». ﴿وَلَهُ عَذابٌ مُهِينٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ, the preposition and its genitive noun being the khabar, and «مهين» an adjective; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:15-16.t:
﴿وَاللَّاتِي﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «اللاتي» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَأْتِينَ الْفاحِشَةَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the nūn of the feminine plural is its fāʿil (agent) and «الفاحشة» its object. ﴿مِنْ نِسائِكُمْ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the response to the relative noun because of its resemblance to a condition, and [then] an imperative verb and its agent, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَرْبَعَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «أربعة». ﴿فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إن» is conditional; «شهدوا» is a past verb and its agent, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ﴾: like «فاستشهدوا», and the hāʾ is a direct object; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the preposition and genitive noun ﴿فِي الْبُيُوتِ﴾ are attached to the verb before them. ﴿حَتَّى يَتَوَفَّاهُنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after «حتى», and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿الْمَوْتُ﴾: its agent; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أمسكوهن».
﴿أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and a direct object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, or to an omitted ḥāl from «سبيلا»; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَالَّذانِ يَأْتِيانِها مِنْكُمْ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, nominative with alif because it is a dual, or indeclinable on kasra in the position of nominative; the clause ﴿يَأْتِيانِها مِنْكُمْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and «منكم» is attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَآذُوهُما﴾: the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «اللذان». ﴿فَإِنْ تابا وَأَصْلَحا﴾: «تابا» is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the alif is the agent; «أصلحا» is conjoined; the clause ﴿فَأَعْرِضُوا عَنْهُما﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ تَوَّاباً رَحِيماً﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded.

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾: [inna with] the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿التَّوْبَةُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لِلَّذِينَ﴾: «التوبة» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the Divine Name is genitive by «على», and [the preposition and noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «للذين» is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ السُّوءَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِجَهالَةٍ﴾: attached to «يعملون». ﴿ثُمَّ يَتُوبُونَ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ﴾: conjoined to «يعملون», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يتوبون». ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined to «إنما التوبة». ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾: kāna, with the Divine Name as its noun (ism), and «عليما حكيما» its predicates; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَيْسَتِ التَّوْبَةُ﴾: laysa and its noun, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ is the ṣila. ﴿حَتَّى إِذا﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit and a preposition; «إذا» is an adverb of the future. ﴿حَضَرَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ﴾: a past verb, a direct object placed first and the agent placed after; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and «حتى» has no governing effect. ﴿قالَ إِنِّي تُبْتُ الْآنَ﴾: the clause ﴿قالَ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿إِنِّي﴾ is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause ﴿تُبْتُ﴾ is the khabar of inna; the adverb «الآن» is attached to the verb before it. ﴿وَلَا الَّذِينَ﴾: conjoined to «الذين», and «لا» is negating with no governing effect; the clause ﴿يَمُوتُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعْتَدْنا لَهُمْ عَذاباً﴾: a past verb, its agent and its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿أَلِيماً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أي» is a munādā (one addressed), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of accusative as vocative; the relative noun is a badal (substitute), and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَرِثُوا النِّساءَ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the imperfect verb is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of «يحل», and «لكم» is attached (mutaʿalliq) to it; «النساء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَرْهاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and «لا» is negating; «تعضلوهن» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent and the hāʾ a direct object. It is also permissible that the wāw be resumptive and «لا» the prohibitive, jussive-making [particle], the imperfect verb being jussive. ﴿لِتَذْهَبُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of purpose; «تذهبوا» is accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of purpose; the interpreted maṣdar, "for going", [with the lām] is attached to «تعضلوهن»; the wāw is the agent. ﴿بِبَعْضِ﴾: attached to «تذهبوا». ﴿ما آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾: «ما» is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; «آتيتموهن» is a past verb, its agent and a direct object; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفاحِشَةٍ﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the excepted; «يأتين» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative, and the nūn of the feminine plural is its agent. ﴿مُبَيِّنَةٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «فاحشة». ﴿وَعاشِرُوهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: an imperative verb, its agent and a direct object; the imperative verb is indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached to it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنْ كَرِهْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is its agent and the hāʾ a direct object, and the wāw is for prolongation (al-ishbāʿ); it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then bear with them". ﴿فَعَسى﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason, and [then] an inflexible (jāmid) past verb. ﴿أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئاً﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and a direct object; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative as the agent of «عسى». ﴿وَيَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ خَيْراً﴾: an imperfect verb; the Divine Name is the agent and «خيرا» a direct object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb and stand as the second object of «يجعل». ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: an adjective; the clause ﴿وَيَجْعَلَ ... ﴾ is conjoined, and the clause ﴿عسى﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:20-21.t: ﴿وَإِنْ أَرَدْتُمُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «أردتم» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿اسْتِبْدالَ﴾: its object. ﴿زَوْجٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَكانَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استبدال». ﴿زَوْجٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَآتَيْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «آتيتم» is a past verb and its agent. ﴿إِحْداهُنَّ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قِنْطاراً﴾: second direct object; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or conjoined. ﴿فَلا تَأْخُذُوا مِنْهُ شَيْئاً﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَتَأْخُذُونَهُ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and [then] an imperfect verb, its agent and a direct object. ﴿بُهْتاناً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); it is also said [to be] a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and ﴿إِثْماً﴾ is conjoined. ﴿مُبِيناً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَكَيْفَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿تَأْخُذُونَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and a direct object. ﴿وَقَدْ أَفْضى بَعْضُكُمْ إِلى بَعْضٍ﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَأَخَذْنَ﴾: a past verb, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the agent. ﴿مِيثاقاً﴾: direct object. ﴿غَلِيظاً﴾: its adjective; and the preposition and genitive noun ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ are attached to «أخذن»; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:22-23.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: prohibitive. ﴿تَنْكِحُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما نَكَحَ﴾: «ما» is a relative noun in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is also said [to be] a maṣdar-particle; the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿آباؤُكُمْ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنَ النِّساءِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «نكح», i.e. «نكحة». ﴿إِلَّا ما قَدْ سَلَفَ﴾: «إلا» is a particle of exception; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted, and the clause after it is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّهُ كانَ فاحِشَةً﴾: inna and its noun (ism), and kāna and its khabar (predicate), its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿وَمَقْتاً﴾: conjoined; the clause «كان» is the khabar of inna, and the clause ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya); the clause ﴿وَساءَ سَبِيلًا﴾ is resumptive, «سبيلا» being a tamyīz (specification), and the agent of the inflexible (jāmid) verb «ساء» being a pronoun explained by the tamyīz. ﴿حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَّهاتُكُمْ﴾: a passive past verb to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached; «أمهاتكم» is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَبَناتُكُمْ﴾: it and what follows it are conjoined. ﴿وَأُمَّهاتُكُمُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿اللَّاتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ﴿أَرْضَعْنَكُمْ﴾ — a past verb, its agent and a direct object — is the ṣila. ﴿وَأَخَواتُكُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الرَّضاعَةِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl from «أخواتكم». ﴿وَأُمَّهاتُ نِسائِكُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَرَبائِبُكُمُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿اللَّاتِي﴾: an adjective. ﴿فِي حُجُورِكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ نِسائِكُمُ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl from «ربائبكم», and the clause ﴿دَخَلْتُمْ بِهِنَّ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُونُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is its noun, and the clause ﴿دَخَلْتُمْ بِهِنَّ﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «تكونوا». ﴿فَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, with its noun indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and its khabar; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَحَلائِلُ أَبْنائِكُمُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ أَصْلابِكُمْ﴾: conjoined, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَأَنْ تَجْمَعُوا بَيْنَ الْأُخْتَيْنِ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative, conjoined; the adverb is attached to «تجمعوا»; «الأختين» is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿إِلَّا ما قَدْ سَلَفَ﴾: it has been parsed before, and likewise ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾.

daas-irab:121-122.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ مَأْواهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (مأواهم) is a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is (جهنم), and the clause ﴿مَأْواهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ﴾ is the khabar of (أولئك). ﴿وَلا يَجِدُونَ عَنْها مَحِيصاً﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (محيصا). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ is maʿṭūf; (الصالحات) is mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ﴾: an imperfect verb and its two objects; the clause is the khabar of (الذين). ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. The clause is a naʿt (adjective). ﴿خالِدِينَ فِيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the ḥāl (خالدين), and the adverb ﴿أَبَداً﴾ is attached to (خالدين). ﴿وَعْدَ اللَّهِ﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَقًّا﴾: a ḥāl; it has also been said to be a mafʿūl muṭlaq as well, i.e. "حق ذلك حقا" (that is true, truly). ﴿وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: (من) is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is (أصدق), to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached. ﴿قِيلًا﴾: tamyīz (specification). The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:123-124.t: ﴿لَيْسَ بِأَمانِيِّكُمْ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); the implied form is: "ليس دخوله الجنة متعلقا بأمانيكم" (his entering Paradise is not dependent on your wishes). ﴿وَلا أَمانِيِّ أَهْلِ الْكِتابِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to what precedes it. ﴿مَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءاً﴾: the jussive protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is latent, and the conditional noun (من) is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُجْزَ بِهِ﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the omission of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "هو" (he). The clause has no grammatical position, not being joined with the fāʾ. The protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من). ﴿وَلا يَجِدْ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلِيًّا﴾: (له) is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (وليا); (من دون) is attached to the verb (يجد), and they [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably the first object is meant to be (له)] are the first object, and the second object is ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾. ﴿وَلا نَصِيراً﴾: conjoined to (وليا), and (لا) is negating. ﴿وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: (يعمل) is the protasis, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; its fāʿil is "هو", and (من) is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ ذَكَرٍ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ أُنْثى﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك), and the clause ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَلا يُظْلَمُونَ نَقِيراً﴾: a passive imperfect verb and its nāʾib fāʿil; (نقيرا) stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:125-126.t: ﴿وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِيناً﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); (دينا) is a tamyīz (specification). ﴿مِمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من). ﴿وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ مِلَّةَ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: a past verb and its object; the fāʿil is latent, and (إبراهيم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa because it is a proper name and foreign. ﴿حَنِيفاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿وَاتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ إِبْراهِيمَ خَلِيلًا﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; (إبراهيم) and (خليلا) are its two objects. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ ما فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: (لله): the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما); (في السموات) is attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun (ما). The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to (ما في السموات). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطاً﴾: (كان), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (بكل) is attached to the khabar (محيطا). The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:127-127.t: ﴿وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّساءِ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its object. The clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ﴾: (فيهن) is attached to the verb (يفتيكم); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الله). The clause ﴿قُلِ﴾ is resumptive, and the clause ﴿اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ﴾ is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the nominative, conjoined to (الله). It may also be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿يُتْلى عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتابِ﴾: (عليكم) is attached to the passive imperfect verb before it, and likewise (في الكتاب); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي يَتامَى﴾: attached to an omitted element, as a badal (substitute) of ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾; it has also been said to be a badal of ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾, i.e. "في حكم" (concerning the ruling on). Attaching them to the verb ﴿يُتْلى﴾ is not far-fetched. ﴿النِّساءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿يُتْلى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿اللَّاتِي لا تُؤْتُونَهُنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿ما كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the passive verb before them; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the relative noun is in the position of the accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause (ترغبون) is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ﴾: conjoined to (يتامى النساء). ﴿مِنَ الْوِلْدانِ﴾: attached to (المستضعفين). ﴿وَأَنْ تَقُومُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to (يتامى النساء) or to (المستضعفين). ﴿لِلْيَتامى﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِالْقِسْطِ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَما تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is its fāʿil, and the conditional noun (ما) is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِهِ عَلِيماً﴾: the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is joined with the fāʾ.

daas-irab:128-129.t: ﴿وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ﴾: (إن) is conditional; (امرأة) is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by the verb after it. ﴿خافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِها نُشُوزاً﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); its fāʿil is latent (mustatir) and (نشوزا) is its object. The clause is explicative. ﴿أَوْ إِعْراضاً﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْهِما﴾: (لا) is the lā of generic negation, and its noun is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَنْ يُصْلِحا بَيْنَهُما﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to the omitted khabar; the adverb (بينهما) is attached to (يصلحا). ﴿صُلْحاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَالصُّلْحُ خَيْرٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is parenthetical. ﴿وَأُحْضِرَتِ الْأَنْفُسُ الشُّحَّ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object; (الشح) is the second object. The clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or parenthetical. ﴿وَإِنْ تُحْسِنُوا﴾: (إن) is conditional; the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) is jussive, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيراً﴾: the clause ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "إن تحسنوا وتتقوا فالله يجازيكم خيرا" (if you do good and are mindful, Allah will reward you well). ﴿وَلَنْ تَسْتَطِيعُوا أَنْ تَعْدِلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the adverb of place ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ is attached to the verb before it. ﴿النِّساءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلَوْ حَرَصْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; (لو) is conditional; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فَلا تَمِيلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive (lā al-nāhiya); the wāw is its fāʿil. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, because it is preceded by the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿كُلَّ الْمَيْلِ﴾: (كل) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq and (الميل) muḍāf ilayhi. The apodosis of (لو) is omitted. ﴿فَتَذَرُوها كَالْمُعَلَّقَةِ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative after the fāʾ of causation (sababiyya); the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ mafʿūl bihi. The interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to an interpreted maṣdar taken from the preceding verb: "لا يكن منكم ميل وترك" (let there be no inclining and leaving on your part). Or the fāʾ is a conjunction and (تذروها) is conjoined to (تميلوا). (كالمعلقة) is attached to (تذروها). ﴿وَإِنْ تُصْلِحُوا﴾: the protasis, jussive by the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا﴾: conjoined. The clause ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is causal, and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "وإن تصلحوا وتتقوا يغفر الله لكم" (and if you set things right and are mindful, Allah will forgive you). ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾: the i'rab of the like of it has preceded.

daas-irab:130-131.t:
﴿وَإِنْ يَتَفَرَّقا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the alif is the fāʿil (agent). The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يُغْنِ اللَّهُ كُلًّا﴾: (يغن) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive by the omission of the weak letter, with its fāʿil and its object. ﴿مِنْ سَعَتِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ واسِعاً حَكِيماً﴾: (كان), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (واسعا) and (عليما) [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse has (حكيما)] are its two khabars (predicates). The clause is resumptive, and the clause ﴿يُغْنِ ... ﴾ has no grammatical position, not being linked with the fāʾ or the (إذا) of surprise. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: (لله): the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to an omitted khabar of the relative (ما); (في السموات) is attached to its omitted ṣila (relative clause), and what follows it is conjoined. ﴿وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the relative noun is its object; the clause is the response to the oath, since it is preceded by the lām of the oath, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, and (الكتاب) is its second object; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾: attached to (أوتوا). ﴿وَإِيَّاكُمْ﴾: a detached accusative pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to (الذين). ﴿أَنِ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: (أن) is maṣdar-forming, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its object; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, i.e. "بتقوى الله" (with being mindful of Allah), and the two are attached to (وصينا). It has also been said that (أن) is explicative. ﴿وَإِنْ تَكْفُرُوا﴾: the protasis, jussive by the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "فلن تضروا الله شيئا" (you will not harm Allah in the least).
The clause ﴿وَإِنْ تَكْفُرُوا﴾ is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, i.e. "وقلنا: إن تكفروا" (and We said: if you disbelieve). The clause of saying is conjoined to the clause (وصينا). ﴿فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: (إن), and the relative noun is its noun; the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to its omitted khabar; (في السموات) is attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun. (وما في الأرض) is conjoined. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَنِيًّا حَمِيداً﴾: its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:132-134.t:
﴿وَلِلَّهِ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in 131. ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا﴾: a past verb; (بالله): the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and (الله), the Name of Majesty, is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, as the fāʿil (agent) of (كفى); (وكيلا) is a tamyīz (specification). The clause is resumptive.
﴿إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), both jussive (majzūm). ﴿أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda); (الناس) is a badal (substitute). The clause is parenthetical. ﴿وَيَأْتِ بِآخَرِينَ﴾: conjoined to (يذهبكم), jussive by the omission of the weak letter; (بآخرين) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلى ذلِكَ قَدِيراً﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar (predicate) (قديرا); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ كانَ﴾: the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the defective (nāqiṣ) verb is in the position of the jussive as the protasis. ﴿يُرِيدُ ثَوابَ الدُّنْيا﴾: an imperfect verb, its object and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (كان), whose noun is a latent pronoun. ﴿فَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ ثَوابُ الدُّنْيا﴾: (عند) is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ثواب); (الدنيا) is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of (من), and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من); the clause ﴿مَنْ كانَ يُرِيدُ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ سَمِيعاً بَصِيراً﴾: the i'rab of the like of it has preceded.

daas-irab:135-135.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ بِالْقِسْطِ﴾: (كان), its noun and its khabar (predicate), to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿شُهَداءَ لِلَّهِ﴾: a second khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached. ﴿وَلَوْ عَلى أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of (كان), which is omitted together with its noun; the implied form is: "ولو كانت الشهادة على أنفسكم" (even if the testimony is against yourselves). (لو) is a conditional particle; the conditional clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "ولو كانت الشهادة على أنفسكم فأدوها" (even if the testimony is against yourselves, give it).
﴿أَوِ الْوالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ﴾: conjoined to (أنفسكم). ﴿إِنْ يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, i.e. the one testified against, and (غنيا) is its khabar. ﴿أَوْ فَقِيراً﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَاللَّهُ أَوْلى بِهِما﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (أولى) is a khabar to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿فَلا تَتَّبِعُوا الْهَوى﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive (lā al-nāhiya), with its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition after the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿أَنْ تَعْدِلُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, i.e. "للعدل" (so as to be just), or "لكراهية العدل" (out of aversion to being just) if it has the sense of deviating. ﴿وَإِنْ تَلْوُوا﴾: the protasis, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أَوْ تُعْرِضُوا﴾: conjoined. The apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: "يجازيكم" (He will requite you). The clause ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), the clause ﴿كانَ بِما﴾ is a khabar, and the clause ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿خَبِيراً﴾: the khabar of (كان).

daas-irab:136-136.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: an imperative verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it, ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾, are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ وَالْكِتابِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿نَزَّلَ عَلى رَسُولِهِ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالْكِتابِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: (قبل) is a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (أنزل). ﴿وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِاللَّهِ﴾: the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and the two are attached to the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) (يكفر). ﴿وَمَلائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ﴾: conjoined to (الله), the Exalted. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾: also conjoined, and (الآخر) is a naʿt. ﴿فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلالًا بَعِيداً﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and its naʿt; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). The clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of (من).

daas-irab:137-138.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: (إن), and the relative noun is its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا ثُمَّ آمَنُوا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ ازْدادُوا كُفْراً﴾: a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a tamyīz (specification); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لَمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن). ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ﴾: the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of (يكن), i.e. "لم يكن مريدا للغفران لهم" (He was not one to intend forgiveness for them); (لهم) is attached to (يغفر). ﴿وَلا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to (ليغفر لهم); the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil being "أنت" (you), first [Translator's note: so in the source, apparently garbled; the fāʿil is the latent "هو" (He), and the hāʾ is the first object]. ﴿سَبِيلًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. The interpreted maṣdar is likewise in the position of the genitive by the preposition. ﴿بَشِّرِ الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾: an imperative verb and a mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ عَذاباً﴾: (أن) and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿أَلِيماً﴾: naʿt (adjective). The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أن) and the verb [Translator's note: so in the source; here it is (أن) with its noun and khabar] is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (بشر). The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وَالْمُحْصَناتُ﴾: conjoined to what preceded. ﴿مِنَ النِّساءِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المحصنات». ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كِتابَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "Allah has prescribed a prescription." ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to the maṣdar «كتاب». ﴿وَأُحِلَّ لَكُمْ ما وَراءَ﴾: a passive past verb, and «ما» is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «لكم» is attached to the verb, and the adverb is attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ تَبْتَغُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is a badal (substitute) of «ما», or genitive by a preposition. ﴿بِأَمْوالِكُمْ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿مُحْصِنِينَ﴾: a first ḥāl. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: a second ḥāl. ﴿مُسافِحِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with yāʾ. ﴿فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and [then] a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿ما﴾ is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْهُنَّ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَآتُوهُنَّ﴾: an imperative verb, its agent and the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أُجُورَهُنَّ﴾: second direct object; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿فَرِيضَةً﴾: a ḥāl meaning "prescribed". ﴿وَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لا» is the lā of generic negation and «جناح» is its noun (ism); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿فِيما﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the clause ﴿تَراضَيْتُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to «تراضيتم». ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الْفَرِيضَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ﴾: «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «لم» is a jussive particle; «يستطع» is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يستطع». ﴿طَوْلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْ يَنْكِحَ الْمُحْصَناتِ﴾: an accusative imperfect verb and a direct object, accusative with kasra; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the object of the maṣdar «طولا», and it is also said to be a badal (substitute) of it. ﴿الْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَمِنْ ما مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "let him marry"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ فَتَياتِكُمُ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted direct object. ﴿الْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾: an adjective. ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمانِكُمْ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ and «أعلم» the khabar (predicate), to which the preposition and genitive noun are attached; the clause is parenthetical, and the wāw is the wāw of parenthesis (iʿtirāḍ). ﴿بَعْضُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ﴾: a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَانْكِحُوهُنَّ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa [indicating an implied condition], and some parse it as conjunctive; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition: "if you know that, then marry them." ﴿بِإِذْنِ أَهْلِهِنَّ﴾: attached to the verb; «أهلهن» is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ مُحْصَناتٍ غَيْرَ مُسافِحاتٍ﴾: the i'rab of something similar has preceded in the previous verse; «بالمعروف» is attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَلا مُتَّخِذاتِ أَخْدانٍ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; «لا» is negating; «متخذات» is conjoined to «مسافحات»; «أخدان» is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِذا أُحْصِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إذا» is an adverb of future time; «أحصن» is a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ أَتَيْنَ﴾: «إن» is conditional; «أتين» is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the nūn of the feminine plural is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِفاحِشَةٍ﴾: attached to «أتين». ﴿فَعَلَيْهِنَّ نِصْفُ ما عَلَى الْمُحْصَناتِ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar placed first. ﴿نِصْفُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: attached to an omitted khabar, and the clause ﴿خَشِيَ الْعَنَتَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَأَنْ تَصْبِرُوا﴾: the protasis, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: so in the source; «تصبروا» is in fact accusative by «أن» (with the dropping of the nūn), not a protasis.] ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: its khabar, i.e. "your patience is better for you"; and the preposition and genitive noun ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ are attached to «خير». ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ and what follows are its two predicates; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:26-27.t: ﴿يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from the omitted «أن» and the verb is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ سُنَنَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾: the kāf is the object of the verb «يهدي» and «سنن» a second object, the agent being «هو» [He]; the relative noun is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, and likewise ﴿وَيَتُوبَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two predicates; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: the Divine Name is the mubtadaʾ and the clause «يريد» its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar is a direct object; «عليكم» is attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَيُرِيدُ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is the agent; the clause ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ الشَّهَواتِ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿أَنْ تَمِيلُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the object of «يريد». ﴿مَيْلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿عَظِيماً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause ﴿وَيُرِيدُ الَّذِينَ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُخَفِّفَ عَنْكُمْ﴾: like ﴿يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُبَيِّنَ﴾. ﴿وَخُلِقَ الْإِنْسانُ ضَعِيفاً﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «ضعيفا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive or gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:29-30.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: it has been parsed before. ﴿لا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوالَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا»; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and «أموالكم» a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ بِالْباطِلِ﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun. ﴿إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ تِجارَةً﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb and its khabar (predicate), its noun (ism) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, i.e. "unless the trade is a trade"; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿عَنْ تَراضٍ﴾: attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «تجارة». ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to «تراض». ﴿وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to «لا تأكلوا أموالكم» and is like it. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيماً﴾: inna and its noun, and kāna and its khabar, to which the preposition and genitive noun before it are attached; its noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause ﴿أَنْ﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; «إنّ» is meant.] ﴿وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذلِكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «يفعل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive, and the demonstrative is its object. ﴿عُدْواناً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَظُلْماً﴾: a conjoined noun. ﴿فَسَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِ ناراً﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «سوف» is a particle of the future, and [then] an imperfect verb and its two objects, its agent latent; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من». ﴿وَكانَ ذلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيراً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿إِنْ تَجْتَنِبُوا كَبائِرَ﴾: «إن» is conditional, and the imperfect verb is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, [with] its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿ما تُنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ﴾: «ما» is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and [then] a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿نُكَفِّرْ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئاتِكُمْ﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), to which the preposition and genitive noun are attached; its agent is latent (mustatir) and «سيئاتكم» is its object. ﴿وَنُدْخِلْكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿مُدْخَلًا﴾: a maṣdar, mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or an adverb attached to the verb before it. ﴿كَرِيماً﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined to «نكفر» and it is the apodosis, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:32-33.t:
﴿وَلا تَتَمَنَّوْا ما فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا», and its fāʿil (agent); the relative noun is its object and the clause after it is its ṣila (relative clause); the clause «ولا تتمنوا ...» is resumptive. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فضل». ﴿بَعْضَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «بعضكم»; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلرِّجالِ نَصِيبٌ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; «نصيب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِمَّا﴾: attached to «نصيب», or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ﴿اكْتَسَبُوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَلِلنِّساءِ نَصِيبٌ مِمَّا اكْتَسَبْنَ﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it and is parsed like it. ﴿وَسْئَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the clause is conjoined to «لا تتمنوا», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from the omitted second object: "and ask Allah for what you want of His bounty." ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيماً﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar «عليما».
«وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنا»: the wāw is resumptive; «لكل» is attached to the verb «جعلنا»; «جعلنا» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the wāw is the agent. [Translator's note: so in the source; the agent is «نا».] ﴿مَوالِيَ﴾: direct object. ﴿مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوالِدانِ﴾: «مما», the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted verb: "and for each We have made heirs who inherit from what … left." ﴿تَرَكَ الْوالِدانِ﴾: a past verb and its agent, nominative with alif because it is a dual. ﴿وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ﴾: conjoined; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «الذين» is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿عَقَدَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَآتُوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is connective because of the relative noun's resemblance to a condition; «آتوهم» is an imperative verb, its agent and its first object, and «نصيبهم» is its second object; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الذين». ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna and its noun (ism). ﴿كانَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيداً﴾: kāna and its khabar, to which the preposition and genitive noun before it are attached; the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:34-34.t:
﴿الرِّجالُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قَوَّامُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative with wāw. ﴿عَلَى النِّساءِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قوامون». ﴿بِما فَضَّلَ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قوامون», and «فضل» is a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: its object. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: attached to «فضل»; the interpreted maṣdar from «ما» and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, i.e. "by [His] favouring", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قوامون». ﴿وَبِما أَنْفَقُوا مِنْ أَمْوالِهِمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes it and is parsed like it. ﴿فَالصَّالِحاتُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «الصالحات» is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿قانِتاتٌ﴾: a first khabar. ﴿حافِظاتٌ لِلْغَيْبِ﴾: a second khabar, to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached. ﴿بِما حَفِظَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its agent; the interpreted maṣdar from «ما» and the verb is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "by Allah's guarding of them." ﴿وَاللَّاتِي﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «اللاتي» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَخافُونَ نُشُوزَهُنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, its agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَعِظُوهُنَّ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the response to the relative noun because of its resemblance to a condition; «عظوهن» is an imperative verb, its agent and its object; the clause is the khabar of «اللاتي». ﴿وَاهْجُرُوهُنَّ فِي الْمَضاجِعِ وَاضْرِبُوهُنَّ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَإِنْ أَطَعْنَكُمْ﴾: a past verb; the nūn of the feminine plural is its agent and the kāf its object; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَلا تَبْغُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ سَبِيلًا﴾: a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, its agent and its object, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna and its noun (ism). ﴿كانَ عَلِيًّا كَبِيراً﴾: kāna and its two predicates, its noun being a latent (mustatir) pronoun.

daas-irab:35-36.t: ﴿وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ﴾: «إن» is a jussive conditional, and [then] a past verb, the tāʾ being its fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿شِقاقَ﴾: its object. ﴿بَيْنِهِما﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَابْعَثُوا حَكَماً﴾: an imperative verb, its agent and its object; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِهِ﴾: [preposition and genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «حكما». ﴿وَحَكَماً مِنْ أَهْلِها﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِنْ يُرِيدا إِصْلاحاً﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the alif of the dual is its agent and «إصلاحا» its object. ﴿يُوَفِّقِ اللَّهُ﴾: the jussive apodosis and its agent; and ﴿بَيْنِهِما﴾ is an adverb of place attached to «يوفق»; the clause is an apodosis with no grammatical position, not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَلِيماً خَبِيراً﴾: the i'rab of its like has preceded. ﴿وَاعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb, its agent and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئاً﴾: «لا» is prohibitive, and [then] an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, to which the preposition and genitive noun after it are attached; the wāw is its agent, and «شيئا» is its object or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَبِالْوالِدَيْنِ إِحْساناً﴾: an absolute object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "and do good", and to this verb the preposition and genitive noun are attached. ﴿وَبِذِي الْقُرْبى وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينِ، وَالْجارِ ذِي الْقُرْبى وَالْجارِ الْجُنُبِ وَالصَّاحِبِ بِالْجَنْبِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾: conjoined to «بالوالدين»; «ذي» is a noun, genitive with yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns; «بالجنب» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الصاحب». ﴿وَما مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾: «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to what precedes it, and the clause ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: inna, with the Divine Name as its noun (ism). ﴿لا يُحِبُّ مَنْ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿كانَ مُخْتالًا فَخُوراً﴾: kāna and its two predicates; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the noun of kāna is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.
